  is_nigo boolean [note: 'Flags whether the beneficiary designation form was received in a Not In Good Order (NIGO) condition — i.e., missing required information, unsigned, or otherwise deficient. NIGO forms require follow-up with the policy owner before the designation can be processed and made effective.']
  jurisdiction_state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code of the jurisdiction governing this beneficiary designation, typically the state where the policy was issued or the insured resides. Determines applicable state insurance law requirements for designation validity, notarization, and beneficiary rights.']
  minor_beneficiary_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the designated beneficiary is a minor (under age 18 or applicable state age of majority). Minor beneficiaries require a guardian or custodian to receive proceeds, triggering special claims payment workflows and UTMA/UGMA account considerations.']
  nigo_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or coded description of the specific deficiency that caused the designation form to be flagged as NIGO. Examples include missing beneficiary SSN/TIN, missing owner signature, illegible form, or missing notarization. Populated only when is_nigo is True.']
  nigo_resolved_date date [note: 'The date on which all NIGO deficiencies were remediated and the designation form was accepted as complete and in good order. Null if the form has not yet been resolved or was not NIGO. Used to measure NIGO resolution cycle time for operational reporting.']
  notarization_date date [note: 'The date on which the beneficiary designation form was notarized, if notarization was required. Null if notarization was not required or has not yet been completed. Used to validate the legal completeness of the designation.']
  notarization_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the designation form required notarization under applicable state law, policy contract terms, or court order. Notarization is commonly required for irrevocable designations and court-ordered changes.']
  prior_beneficiary_snapshot varchar [note: 'A serialized summary of the beneficiary designation(s) that were in force immediately before this designation change was processed. Stored as a structured text snapshot (e.g., JSON-encoded summary) to support audit trail requirements and claims adjudication without requiring a full historical join. Captures prior beneficiary name, type, allocation percentage, and effective date.']
  processed_date date [note: 'The date the designation change was fully processed and recorded in the Policy Administration System. Represents the completion of the administrative workflow, distinct from the received date and the effective date.']
  received_date date [note: 'The date the beneficiary designation form or request was physically or electronically received by the insurer or its TPA. May differ from effective_date if the form required NIGO remediation or administrative processing time.']
  remarks varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or administrative comments entered by the processing representative regarding this beneficiary designation event. Examples include notes on court order interpretation, special payment instructions, or follow-up actions required.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this designation record originated. \'PAS\' = Policy Administration System (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro); \'CRM\' = CRM and Customer Engagement Platform; \'PORTAL\' = online self-service portal; \'TPA\' = Third Party Administrator submission; \'PAPER\' = paper form manually keyed; \'ANNUITY\' = Annuity Administration Platform.']
  stoli_review_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this beneficiary designation triggered a STOLI (Stranger-Originated Life Insurance) review. STOLI arrangements involve designating a stranger or investor as beneficiary to circumvent insurable interest requirements. Flagged designations require compliance review and may result in policy rescission.']
  superseded_date date [note: 'The date on which this designation was superseded by a subsequent designation change. Null if the designation is currently active or was revoked/rejected. Enables point-in-time reconstruction of the beneficiary designation history for audit and claims adjudication.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this beneficiary designation record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks the most recent update to the record for change data capture, audit trail, and data quality monitoring purposes.']
  witness_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the designation form required a witness signature under applicable state law or policy contract terms. Certain states and irrevocable designations mandate witnessed signatures for legal validity.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing each formal beneficiary designation event — the act of naming, changing, or revoking a beneficiary on a policy or annuity contract. Stores designation effective date, prior beneficiary snapshot, new beneficiary allocation percentages, designation method (written form, e-signature, court order), NIGO flag if the form was not in good order, and processing status. Distinct from the beneficiary master record — this captures the lifecycle of designation changes over time for audit and claims adjudication purposes.'

Table policyholder.communication_preference {
  communication_preference_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each communication preference record. Primary key for the communication_preference data product in the policyholder domain.']
  party_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the policyholder party (insured, contract owner, annuitant, or beneficiary) whose communication preferences are governed by this record. Links to the master party entity in the policyholder domain.']
  cease_and_desist boolean [note: 'Indicates the party has issued a formal cease-and-desist demand requiring all non-legally-required outbound contact to stop immediately. True = all non-mandatory communications suppressed across all channels. Overrides all positive preferences. Triggers legal review workflow and must be honored within legally required timeframes.']
  channel varchar [note: 'The specific outbound communication channel to which this preference or restriction applies: phone (voice calls), email (electronic mail), mail (physical postal mail), sms (text messaging), fax (facsimile), e_delivery_portal (secure online document delivery portal). Drives channel-level suppression and routing logic in CRM, billing notification, and marketing systems.']
  consent_ip_address varchar [note: 'The IP address from which the party submitted their online consent or opt-in for electronic communications. Used as part of the digital consent audit trail to demonstrate affirmative consent under TCPA and e-delivery statutes. Applicable only for online/portal/mobile consent captures.']
  consent_version varchar [note: 'The version identifier of the consent language, privacy notice, or terms and conditions under which the party provided their communication preference or opt-in consent. Enables tracking of consent obtained under specific regulatory disclosure versions. Critical for demonstrating TCPA prior express written consent and CAN-SPAM compliance.']
  contact_purpose varchar [note: 'The business purpose category for which this preference or restriction applies. marketing = promotional and cross-sell outreach; billing = premium notices and payment reminders; policy_service = policy change confirmations and servicing notices; claims = claim status and settlement communications; legal = regulatory and legal notices; all = applies across all contact purposes. Enables granular suppression by purpose.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this communication preference record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail start point for regulatory compliance reviews and market conduct examinations. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.']
  dnc_scrub_date date [note: 'The most recent date on which the party\'s contact information was scrubbed against national and state Do-Not-Call registries. Required for demonstrating compliance with FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule requirement to scrub calling lists against DNC registries at least every 31 days.']
  do_not_call boolean [note: 'Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by telephone for any purpose (marketing or service). True = all outbound voice calls suppressed. Aggregates consumer requests, TCPA restrictions, and state DNC registry matches. Consumed by CRM and dialer systems as the authoritative call suppression signal.']
  do_not_email boolean [note: 'Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by email for any purpose. True = all outbound email suppressed. Consumed by CRM, billing notification, and marketing systems as the authoritative email suppression signal.']
  do_not_mail boolean [note: 'Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by physical postal mail for any purpose. True = all outbound postal mail suppressed. Consumed by billing and policy servicing systems as the authoritative mail suppression signal.']
  do_not_sms boolean [note: 'Master suppression flag indicating the party must not be contacted by SMS/text message for any purpose. True = all outbound SMS suppressed. Consumed by CRM and notification systems as the authoritative SMS suppression signal.']
  document_delivery_method varchar [note: 'The party\'s preferred method for receiving policy documents, statements, and notices: paper = physical mail delivery; email = documents delivered as email attachments or links; e_delivery_portal = secure online portal access; fax = facsimile delivery. Governs delivery of policy contracts, annual statements, premium notices, and regulatory disclosures.']
  e_delivery_consent_date date [note: 'The date on which the party provided affirmative consent to electronic document delivery. Required for regulatory audit trail demonstrating compliance with state e-delivery consent requirements. Null if e_delivery_enrolled is False.']
  e_delivery_consent_method varchar [note: 'The channel or mechanism through which the party provided e-delivery consent: online_portal = self-service web portal; mobile_app = mobile application; agent_assisted = captured by agent during policy application or servicing; written_form = paper consent form; ivr = interactive voice response system. Supports regulatory audit of consent capture method.']
  e_delivery_enrolled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party has affirmatively enrolled in electronic document delivery (e-delivery) for policy documents and notices. True = enrolled and consented to e-delivery; False = not enrolled, paper delivery applies. Required for compliance with state e-delivery consent statutes which mandate affirmative opt-in before electronic delivery of insurance documents.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which this communication preference or restriction becomes effective and must be honored by all outbound contact systems. For do-not-contact restrictions, this is the date from which suppression is required. For positive preferences, this is the date the preference takes effect.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which this communication preference or restriction expires and is no longer binding. Null indicates the preference is open-ended with no expiration. Applicable to time-limited restrictions (e.g., temporary litigation holds, state DNC registry registrations with renewal requirements).']
  hipaa_restriction boolean [note: 'Indicates the party has invoked their HIPAA right to restrict communications related to health information to specific channels or purposes. True = HIPAA-directed communication restriction is in effect; specific restrictions are detailed in the restriction_type and channel fields. Governs HIPAA-compliant communication management for health-related insurance products.']
  hipaa_restriction_detail varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the specific HIPAA-directed communication restriction invoked by the party, including restricted channels, restricted purposes, and any alternative contact instructions provided. Null if hipaa_restriction is False. Treated as confidential due to potential health information context.']
  litigation_hold boolean [note: 'Indicates that legal counsel has placed a litigation hold on outbound contact with this party, typically due to pending or anticipated litigation. True = all non-legally-required communications suppressed pending legal clearance. Overrides all positive preferences and marketing opt-ins.']
  marketing_opt_in_email boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via email. True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs CAN-SPAM and state law compliant outbound marketing email campaigns. Distinct from transactional/service email which may not require opt-in.']
  marketing_opt_in_mail boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via physical postal mail. True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs outbound direct mail marketing campaigns and suppression list management.']
  marketing_opt_in_phone boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via telephone (voice calls). True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs TCPA-compliant outbound marketing call campaigns. Must be False by default; requires affirmative opt-in.']
  marketing_opt_in_sms boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party has opted in to receive marketing communications via SMS/text message. True = opted in; False = not opted in or opted out. Governs TCPA-compliant outbound marketing text message campaigns. Requires prior express written consent under TCPA for autodialed or prerecorded messages.']
  national_dnc_registered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party\'s phone number is registered on the FTC National Do-Not-Call Registry. True = registered; outbound telemarketing calls are prohibited under FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule. Populated via mandatory periodic scrubbing of the national DNC registry.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional context, special instructions, or documentation related to this communication preference record. Examples include specific instructions from legal counsel regarding a litigation hold, details of a consumer complaint that triggered a restriction, or special accommodation notes. Not used for structured data.']
  opt_out_channel varchar [note: 'The channel through which the party submitted their opt-out or do-not-contact request: phone = verbal request via inbound call; email = email opt-out request; mail = written postal request; online_portal = self-service web portal; mobile_app = mobile application; agent = captured by agent; written_request = formal written letter. Required for regulatory audit trail. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phone|email|mail|online_portal|mobile_app|agent|written_request — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  opt_out_date date [note: 'The date on which the party submitted an opt-out or do-not-contact request. Distinct from effective_date (when the restriction takes effect) and from the record creation timestamp. Required for regulatory audit trail and for measuring compliance with legally mandated opt-out processing timeframes (e.g., CAN-SPAM 10-business-day requirement).']
  preference_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of this preference record. Active = currently governing outbound contact decisions. Inactive = deactivated by party or system. Pending = awaiting confirmation or effective date. Expired = past expiration date. Superseded = replaced by a newer preference record.']
  preference_type varchar [note: 'High-level classification of this preference record: positive_preference (party-directed opt-in or channel/format choice), do_not_contact (regulatory or consumer-directed restriction), cease_and_desist (formal written demand to stop all contact), litigation_hold (legal counsel-directed contact freeze pending litigation).']
  preferred_contact_time_end varchar [note: 'The latest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour local time) at which the party prefers to be contacted. Used in conjunction with preferred_contact_time_start to define the party\'s preferred contact window. Supports TCPA compliance scheduling.']
  preferred_contact_time_start varchar [note: 'The earliest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour local time) at which the party prefers to be contacted. Used by CRM and dialer systems to schedule outbound calls and notifications within the party\'s preferred window. Supports TCPA compliance by avoiding calls outside permissible hours.']
  preferred_contact_timezone varchar [note: 'The IANA timezone identifier (e.g., America/New_York, America/Chicago) representing the party\'s local timezone for scheduling outbound contact. Required to correctly apply TCPA calling hour restrictions (8am–9pm local time) and the party\'s preferred contact window.']
  preferred_language varchar [note: 'The party\'s preferred language for all communications, expressed as an IETF BCP 47 language tag (e.g., en-US, es-MX, zh-CN, fr-CA). Governs language selection for policy documents, billing notices, and marketing materials. Required for compliance with state insurance department language access requirements.']
  restriction_source varchar [note: 'The originating authority or mechanism that established a do-not-contact restriction. consumer_request = party-initiated opt-out; tcpa = Telephone Consumer Protection Act compliance trigger; state_dnc_registry = state Do-Not-Call registry match; legal_counsel = internal or external legal counsel directive; court_order = court-issued injunction; regulatory_order = state DOI or federal regulatory directive. Null for positive preference records.']
  restriction_type varchar [note: 'Specific type of do-not-contact restriction when preference_type is do_not_contact, cease_and_desist, or litigation_hold. Null for positive preference records. do_not_call = voice call suppression; do_not_mail = postal mail suppression; do_not_email = email suppression; do_not_sms = text message suppression; cease_and_desist = all-channel formal restriction; litigation_hold = legal hold on all contact. Drives suppression logic in all outbound systems.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this communication preference was captured or last updated: crm = CRM/Customer Engagement Platform (Salesforce FSC, MS Dynamics); policy_admin = Policy Administration System; billing = Billing and Premium Collection System; annuity_admin = Annuity Administration Platform; agent_portal = agent-facing portal; online_portal = policyholder self-service portal; mobile_app = mobile application; ivr = interactive voice response; manual = manual data entry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crm|policy_admin|billing|annuity_admin|agent_portal|online_portal|mobile_app|ivr|manual — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  state_dnc_registered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party\'s phone number has been identified as registered on a state Do-Not-Call registry. True = registered on one or more state DNC registries; outbound marketing calls are prohibited. Populated via periodic DNC registry scrubbing processes. Distinct from consumer-requested do_not_call flag.']
  state_dnc_registry_state varchar [note: 'The two-letter US state code of the state DNC registry on which the party\'s number is registered. Applicable when state_dnc_registered is True. Used to apply state-specific telemarketing restrictions which may be more restrictive than federal TCPA requirements.']
  updated_by_party_type varchar [note: 'The type of party who last updated this communication preference record: policyholder = self-service update by the insured or contract owner; agent = licensed agent; broker = independent broker; tpa = Third Party Administrator; legal_counsel = internal or external legal counsel (for litigation holds and cease-and-desist); system = automated system update (e.g., DNC scrub); customer_service = customer service representative. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: policyholder|agent|broker|tpa|legal_counsel|system|customer_service — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this communication preference record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail maintenance, and downstream system synchronization. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.']

  Note: 'Master record storing a policyholder party\'s explicit communication preferences and all regulatory/consumer-directed contact restrictions. Positive preferences: preferred language, document delivery method (paper, email, e-delivery portal), e-delivery enrollment status, marketing opt-in flags by channel. Negative restrictions (do-not-contact): do-not-call, do-not-mail, do-not-email, cease-and-desist, litigation hold — with restriction type, restriction source (consumer request, TCPA, state DNC registry, legal counsel), effective date, expiration date, and applicable communication channels. SSOT for all outbound contact governance — both preferences and restrictions. Ensures compliance with TCPA, CAN-SPAM, state telemarketing laws, HIPAA-compliant communication management, state DOI e-delivery statutes, and internal legal hold obligations. Consumed by CRM, billing notification, and marketing systems for every outbound contact decision.'
}

Table policyholder.group_sponsor {
  group_sponsor_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the group sponsor (employer, association, or plan sponsor) record in the Silver layer. Primary key for the master party record representing the B2B group relationship owner.']
  party_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to policyholder.party. Business justification: Group sponsors are legal entities (employers, associations) that should be represented in the party supertype. Currently group_sponsor stores legal_name and fein directly, but these are party-level at']
  aml_risk_rating varchar [note: 'Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk rating assigned to the group sponsor based on entity due diligence, industry type, geographic risk, and transaction patterns. Determines enhanced due diligence requirements and monitoring frequency per FinCEN BSA/AML program.']
  billing_mode varchar [note: 'Frequency at which the group sponsor is billed for group premiums. List bill mode indicates individual certificate-level billing consolidated to the sponsor. Drives premium schedule generation and grace period calculations in the Billing and Premium Collection System.']
  contract_anniversary_date date [note: 'Annual anniversary date of the group contract, used to trigger renewal underwriting reviews, experience rating adjustments, rate changes, and annual compliance certifications. Typically one year after the contract effective date.']
  contract_effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the group insurance or annuity contract between the insurer and the group sponsor became effective. Marks the start of coverage for eligible certificate holders and the beginning of the billing cycle.']
  contract_termination_date date [note: 'Date on which the group contract was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null for active contracts. Triggers cessation of coverage for all certificate holders and final billing reconciliation.']
  contributory_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the group plan is employer-paid (non-contributory), employee-paid (voluntary), or cost-shared (contributory). Determines minimum participation requirements, underwriting rules, and premium billing allocation between employer and employee.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the group sponsor record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record retention requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  dba_name varchar [note: 'Trade name or \'doing business as\' name used by the group sponsor if different from the legal name. Supports customer-facing communications and billing statements where the sponsor operates under a trade name.']
  dol_plan_year_end varchar [note: 'Month and day (MM-DD) representing the end of the ERISA plan year for DOL Form 5500 filing purposes. Determines the annual reporting deadline (7 months after plan year end). Null for non-ERISA plans.']
  enrolled_count varchar [note: 'Current number of active certificate holders (employees or members) enrolled under the group contract. Used for participation rate monitoring, billing reconciliation, and minimum participation compliance checks.']
  erisa_plan_number varchar [note: 'Three-digit plan number assigned by the plan sponsor for ERISA-qualified group benefit plans, as reported on DOL Form 5500. Required for ERISA compliance reporting and DOL audit trail. Null for non-ERISA plans.']
  group_size varchar [note: 'Total number of eligible employees or members in the group sponsor\'s organization at the time of contract inception or most recent renewal. Used for underwriting risk assessment, experience rating, and determining minimum participation requirements.']
  kyc_status varchar [note: 'Current Know Your Customer (KYC) verification status for the group sponsor entity. Required under FinCEN AML/BSA regulations for business entity due diligence. \'Exempt\' applies to governmental entities. Drives AML case creation and onboarding workflow.']
  mailing_address_line1 varchar [note: 'First line of the group sponsor\'s mailing address used for premium billing statements, contract documents, and regulatory correspondence. Typically the street address or P.O. Box.']
  mailing_address_line2 varchar [note: 'Second line of the group sponsor\'s mailing address (suite, floor, department, or attention line). Optional supplemental address information.']
  mailing_city varchar [note: 'City of the group sponsor\'s mailing address. Used for billing correspondence, regulatory filings, and geographic segmentation of group business.']
  mailing_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter U.S. state code of the group sponsor\'s mailing address. Used for premium tax situs determination and state regulatory compliance.']
  mailing_zip varchar [note: 'ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the group sponsor\'s mailing address. Used for billing correspondence, geographic risk segmentation, and premium tax reporting.']
  naics_code varchar [note: 'Six-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code identifying the primary industry sector of the group sponsor. Preferred over SIC for modern underwriting risk segmentation and actuarial experience studies.']
  ofac_screen_date date [note: 'Most recent date on which the group sponsor was screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Used to track screening currency and trigger re-screening at required intervals.']
  ofac_screened boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the group sponsor has been screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and other sanctions lists. Required for AML compliance prior to contract issuance and at periodic review intervals.']
  open_enrollment_month varchar [note: 'Calendar month (1–12) during which the group sponsor conducts its annual open enrollment period, allowing eligible employees to enroll or change coverage elections without evidence of insurability. Drives enrollment processing workflows.']
  participation_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of eligible employees or members currently enrolled in the group plan, calculated as enrolled_count divided by group_size. Used to assess compliance with minimum participation requirements (typically 75% for contributory plans) and underwriting eligibility.']

  primary_contact_title varchar [note: 'Job title of the primary contact at the group sponsor (e.g., HR Director, Benefits Manager, CFO). Used for professional correspondence and to assess authorization level for plan changes.']
  sic_code varchar [note: 'Four-digit Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) code identifying the primary industry of the group sponsor. Used for underwriting risk assessment, experience rating, and actuarial grouping. Maintained by the U.S. Department of Labor.']
  situs_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter U.S. state code representing the state where the group insurance contract is delivered and governed. May differ from state of domicile. Determines which state\'s insurance laws and mandated benefits apply to the group contract.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational Policy Administration System from which this group sponsor record was sourced (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle IPAS). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Silver layer.']
  source_system_sponsor_code varchar [note: 'Native identifier for the group sponsor record in the originating Policy Administration System (e.g., group number in Sapiens LifePro or FAST). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability from the Silver layer back to the system of record.']
  sponsor_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier assigned to the group sponsor by the Policy Administration System (e.g., Sapiens LifePro, FAST). Used on group contracts, billing invoices, and ERISA filings to uniquely reference the sponsoring organization.']
  sponsor_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the group sponsor record. Drives eligibility for new certificate issuance, billing processing, and ERISA compliance reporting. \'Pending\' indicates the group application is under review; \'Suspended\' indicates a temporary hold due to non-payment or compliance issues.']
  sponsor_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the group sponsor entity type. Determines applicable regulatory framework, billing structure, and ERISA qualification rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employer|association|trust|government|taft_hartley|church_plan|other — promote to reference product]']
  state_of_domicile varchar [note: 'Two-letter U.S. state code representing the state where the group sponsor is legally domiciled or incorporated. Determines applicable state insurance regulations, premium tax situs, and state Department of Insurance jurisdiction for group contract compliance.']
  tpa_administered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the group plan is administered by a Third Party Administrator (TPA) rather than directly by the insurer. When true, TPA contact and agreement details are required for claims adjudication and billing coordination.']
  tpa_name varchar [note: 'Legal name of the Third Party Administrator (TPA) responsible for administering the group plan on behalf of the sponsor. Populated only when tpa_administered is true. Used for claims routing, billing coordination, and regulatory reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the group sponsor record was most recently updated in the Silver layer data product. Supports change data capture, audit trail, and data quality monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  waiting_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of days a new employee must be employed before becoming eligible for group coverage. Commonly 0, 30, 60, or 90 days. Used by the Policy Administration System to determine certificate effective dates for new enrollees.']

  Note: 'Master record for employer groups, associations, or plan sponsors that hold group life insurance or group annuity contracts on behalf of their members or employees. Stores sponsor legal name, FEIN/TIN, SIC/NAICS industry code, group size, plan type (employer-sponsored, association, ERISA-qualified), DOL/ERISA plan number, state of domicile, and contract effective date. SSOT for the B2B group relationship that links individual certificate holders to their sponsoring organization. Supports group billing and ERISA compliance reporting.'

  qualifying_event_type varchar [note: 'The type of qualifying life event that triggered a mid-year enrollment or coverage change outside of open enrollment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marriage|divorce|birth|adoption|loss_of_other_coverage|death_of_dependent|other — promote to reference product]']
  salary_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The group member\'s annual base salary as reported by the group sponsor, expressed in USD. Used to calculate salary-multiple coverage amounts and validate benefit elections against plan maximums.']

  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the policy administration system of record from which this ownership transfer record was sourced (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle IPAS).']

  transfer_for_value_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the ownership transfer constitutes a transfer-for-value under IRC Section 7702, which may affect the income tax treatment of death benefit proceeds. Critical for tax compliance reporting.']
  transfer_reason varchar [note: 'Business reason or motivation for the ownership transfer event. Used for actuarial analysis, compliance reporting, and customer segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: estate_planning|divorce_settlement|business_succession|loan_collateral|gift|court_order|ilit_funding|corporate_restructuring — promote to reference product]']
  transfer_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier assigned by the policy administration system (FAST, Sapiens LifePro) to uniquely identify this ownership change transaction for correspondence, audit, and regulatory reporting.']
  transfer_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the ownership transfer request within the policy administration system. Drives processing queues and compliance holds.']
  transfer_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the ownership transfer event indicating the legal mechanism used. Absolute assignment conveys full ownership rights; collateral assignment pledges the policy as loan security; trust transfer moves ownership to a trust entity (e.g., ILIT); corporate ownership change reflects business entity ownership; divorce decree and court order are legally mandated transfers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: absolute_assignment|collateral_assignment|trust_transfer|corporate_ownership_change|divorce_decree|court_order — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this ownership transfer record was most recently modified in the Silver layer lakehouse, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing each policy or annuity ownership transfer event — absolute assignment, collateral assignment, trust transfer, or corporate ownership change. Stores transfer type, prior owner reference, new owner reference, transfer effective date, transfer reason, legal documentation type (absolute assignment form, court order, divorce decree), NIGO flag, and processing status. Supports policy administration system (FAST, Sapiens LifePro) ownership change workflows and IRC Section 7702 transfer-for-value rule compliance.'
}

Current model only links consent to life insurance policies. A']
  in_force_policy_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the life insurance policy or annuity contract associated with this consent record, when consent is policy-specific rather than party-wide.']

Enables retrieval of the original consent artifact for regulatory audits.']
  party_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the policyholder, annuitant, beneficiary, or other party who granted or withdrew consent. Links to the master party record in the policyholder domain.']
  privacy_incident_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.privacy_incident. Business justification: Privacy breach investigations require knowing what consents were in place to assess notification obligations and data exposure scope. Incident response teams link affected consent records to incidents']

  superseded_by_consent_record_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the newer consent_record_id that replaces this record when consent_status = superseded. Enables forward-chaining of consent version history for audit and compliance purposes.']
  uw_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to underwriting.application. Business justification: Consents (HIPAA authorization for APS/medical records, e-delivery, marketing) are collected during application. Linking consent to application tracks regulatory compliance at underwriting, supports ev']
  channel varchar [note: 'The interaction channel through which the consent was obtained or withdrawn. Distinct from consent_method (which describes the signature/authorization mechanism). Supports omnichannel analytics and channel-specific compliance requirements.']
  consent_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the policyholder or party granted consent. Represents the business event date of the consent action, distinct from the system capture timestamp.']
  consent_language_code varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) indicating the language in which the consent form or disclosure was presented to the policyholder (e.g., en, es, zh-TW). Supports state-mandated language access requirements.']
  consent_method varchar [note: 'The mechanism by which consent was obtained. wet_signature = physical ink signature on paper form; e_signature = electronic signature per ESIGN/UETA; verbal_recorded = recorded verbal authorization; portal_click_through = online portal acceptance; written_mail = written consent submitted via postal mail.']
  consent_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally visible, human-readable identifier assigned to this consent event by the source system (e.g., CRM or Policy Administration System). Used for audit trails, regulatory inquiries, and consumer rights requests.']
  consent_scope varchar [note: 'Free-text or structured description of the specific scope of consent granted, including which data elements, third parties, or communications channels are covered. For HIPAA authorizations, describes the PHI categories authorized for disclosure and the purpose of the disclosure.']
  consent_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the consent record. active = consent is in force; withdrawn = consumer has revoked consent; expired = consent lapsed past its validity period; pending = consent obtained but not yet validated/confirmed; superseded = replaced by a newer consent record of the same type.']
  consent_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the consent event was captured by the source system. Used for regulatory audit trails requiring exact time of consent capture, particularly for electronic and portal-based consents.']
  consent_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the consent event indicating the regulatory or operational category. Values: hipaa_authorization (HIPAA Privacy Rule authorization for PHI disclosure), e_delivery (electronic delivery of policy documents per state e-delivery statutes), marketing_opt_in (marketing communications consent), data_sharing (third-party data sharing consent), electronic_signature (consent to use electronic signatures per ESIGN/UETA), do_not_call (Do Not Call registry preference). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hipaa_authorization|e_delivery|marketing_opt_in|data_sharing|electronic_signature|do_not_call|tcpa_sms|gdpr_processing — promote to reference product]']
  consent_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the consent form, disclosure notice, or authorization template presented to the policyholder at the time of consent. Enables tracking of which version of the consent language was accepted, critical for regulatory compliance when form language changes.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Represents the system audit creation time, distinct from consent_timestamp which reflects the business event time.']
  data_sharing_parties varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list or description of specific third-party entities or categories authorized to receive policyholder data under this consent record. Populated when data_sharing_third_party_flag = true.']
  data_sharing_third_party_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the policyholder has consented to sharing of their personal data with affiliated or non-affiliated third parties (e.g., reinsurers, MIB, TPAs, marketing partners). True = consent granted. Governs data sharing under GLBA and NAIC Model Privacy Act opt-out provisions.']
  device_fingerprint varchar [note: 'Hashed or tokenized identifier representing the device characteristics of the policyholder\'s device at the time of electronic consent. Supports non-repudiation and fraud detection for portal-based and e-signature consents.']
  do_not_contact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates that the policyholder has requested no contact for any purpose beyond contractual obligations. True = suppress all non-essential outreach. Overrides marketing_opt_in_flag and other channel preferences.']
  e_delivery_email varchar [note: 'Email address designated by the policyholder for receipt of electronic policy documents and notices at the time of e-delivery enrollment. May differ from the primary contact email on the party record.']
  e_delivery_enrolled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the policyholder has actively enrolled in electronic delivery of policy documents, statements, and notices. True = enrolled in e-delivery. Drives document delivery routing in the Policy Administration System.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date on which this consent record expires and is no longer valid, if a defined expiration period applies. Null indicates open-ended consent with no defined expiry. HIPAA authorizations may specify an expiration date or event.']
  hipaa_authorization_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this consent record constitutes a HIPAA Privacy Rule authorization for the use or disclosure of Protected Health Information (PHI). True = this record is a HIPAA authorization subject to 45 CFR §164.508 requirements.']
  hipaa_disclosure_purpose varchar [note: 'Description of the purpose for which PHI may be used or disclosed under this HIPAA authorization, as required by 45 CFR §164.508(c)(1)(iv). Examples: underwriting, claims adjudication, attending physician statement (APS) review. Populated only when hipaa_authorization_flag = true.']
  hipaa_phi_categories varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list of PHI categories authorized for disclosure under this HIPAA authorization (e.g., medical records, prescription history, mental health records, HIV/AIDS status). Required element of a valid HIPAA authorization per 45 CFR §164.508(c)(1)(i). Populated only when hipaa_authorization_flag = true.']
  hipaa_recipient varchar [note: 'Name or description of the person or entity authorized to receive PHI under this HIPAA authorization, as required by 45 CFR §164.508(c)(1)(ii). May reference a reinsurer, MIB, attending physician, or third-party administrator (TPA). Populated only when hipaa_authorization_flag = true.']
  ip_address varchar [note: 'IP address of the device used by the policyholder at the time of electronic consent capture (portal click-through or e-signature). Provides technical evidence of consent for ESIGN Act compliance and fraud investigation.']
  jurisdiction_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state or territory code (ISO 3166-2:US subdivision) governing this consent record. Determines which state-specific e-delivery statutes, privacy laws, and insurance regulations apply.']
  marketing_channel_preferences varchar [note: 'Comma-delimited list of communication channels the policyholder has consented to for marketing purposes (e.g., email, sms, phone, direct_mail). Granular channel-level preferences support TCPA compliance and CRM segmentation.']
  marketing_opt_in_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the policyholder has opted in to receive marketing communications from the insurer. True = opted in. Drives CRM campaign eligibility and suppression list management.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operational notes, exception documentation, or additional context related to this consent record (e.g., verbal consent call reference number, special circumstances, compliance officer annotations).']
  regulatory_basis varchar [note: 'The primary regulatory framework or statute that mandates or governs this consent record. Drives compliance reporting and retention requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hipaa|ccpa|gdpr|tcpa|esign|state_e_delivery|naic_privacy|erisa|glba — promote to reference product]']
  retention_expiry_date date [note: 'Date after which this consent record may be purged or anonymized per the applicable records retention schedule. Derived from regulatory retention requirements (e.g., HIPAA requires 6-year retention of authorization records; state insurance regulations may require longer periods).']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this consent record originated (e.g., CRM = Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, PAS = Policy Administration System, PORTAL = self-service web portal). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CRM|PAS|ANNUITY|CLAIMS|BILLING|UNDERWRITING|PORTAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  source_system_consent_code varchar [note: 'The native identifier assigned to this consent record by the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce record ID, PAS consent transaction ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the Silver Layer data product. Supports change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and incremental ETL processing.']
  withdrawal_date date [note: 'Date on which the policyholder or party revoked or withdrew this consent. Populated only when consent_status = withdrawn. Supports GDPR right-to-withdraw and HIPAA revocation tracking.']
  withdrawal_method varchar [note: 'The mechanism by which the policyholder or party withdrew consent. Populated only when consent_status = withdrawn. Required for regulatory audit trails demonstrating the revocation process.']
  withdrawal_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the reason provided by the policyholder or party for withdrawing consent. Supports customer experience analysis and regulatory inquiry responses.']
  witnessed_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the individual who witnessed the consent event (e.g., agent, notary, call center representative). Relevant for wet signature and verbal recorded consent methods.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing explicit consumer consent events for data sharing, e-delivery enrollment, marketing communications, and HIPAA authorizations. Stores consent type (HIPAA authorization, e-delivery consent, marketing opt-in, data sharing consent, electronic signature consent), consent date, consent method (wet signature, e-signature, verbal recorded, portal click-through), consent scope, withdrawal date, and regulatory basis. Supports HIPAA Privacy Rule compliance, state e-delivery statutes, and GDPR/CCPA obligations for applicable policyholders.'
}

Table policyholder.party {
  party_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system identifier for the party record. Primary key. Serves as the single source of truth for any individual or legal entity participating in the policyholder domain across all roles (insured, owner, annuitant, beneficiary, trustee, etc.).']
  guardian_party_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on party (guardian_party_id)']
  aml_risk_rating varchar [note: 'Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk classification for the party based on customer due diligence (CDD) assessment. Low indicates standard risk. Medium indicates elevated risk requiring enhanced monitoring. High indicates significant risk requiring enhanced due diligence (EDD). Prohibited indicates party cannot be onboarded due to AML concerns.']
  citizenship_country varchar [note: 'Country of citizenship for the party. Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR).   gender varchar [note: 'Gender of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types. Used for mortality table selection, underwriting risk classification, and actuarial valuation. Non_binary and unknown options support inclusive data capture and regulatory compliance in jurisdictions requiring gender diversity recognition.']
  grantor_name varchar [note: 'Name of the grantor (settlor) who established the trust. Populated only when party_type is trust. Used for grantor trust tax rules, insurable interest verification, and estate planning documentation.']
  kyc_status varchar [note: 'Current status of Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification for the party. Verified indicates successful identity verification. Pending indicates verification in progress. Failed indicates verification failure requiring manual review. Expired indicates verification has lapsed and requires renewal. Exempt indicates party is exempt from KYC (e.g., institutional entities).']
  kyc_verified_date date [note: 'Date the party successfully completed KYC identity verification. Used for KYC expiration tracking and periodic re-verification scheduling per AML program requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  last_name varchar [note: 'Surname or family name of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types. Primary sorting and indexing field for individual parties.']
  legal_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the party as it appears on government-issued identification or legal formation documents. For individuals: full name including middle name/initial. For entities: registered legal name as filed with state or jurisdiction of formation. Used for policy issuance, tax reporting (1099, 1042-S), and regulatory filings.']
  middle_name varchar [note: 'Middle name or middle initial of the individual party. Null for non-individual party types. Supports full name matching for identity verification and MIB (Medical Information Bureau) checks.']
  ofac_last_screened_date date [note: 'Date the party was last screened against OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and other sanctions lists. Used for periodic re-screening scheduling per AML program requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  ofac_screening_status varchar [note: 'Status of Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) sanctions screening for the party. Clear indicates no match to OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list. Match indicates potential match requiring investigation. Pending_review indicates match under investigation. Blocked indicates confirmed OFAC match prohibiting business relationship.']
  party_number varchar [note: 'Business-facing unique identifier for the party. Human-readable reference number used in correspondence, customer service, and external communications.']
  party_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the party. Active indicates normal operational state. Deceased triggers death benefit processing. Incapacitated may require guardian or power of attorney. Sanctioned indicates OFAC or regulatory restriction. Fraud_flagged indicates suspected fraudulent activity requiring investigation.']
  party_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the party entity. Distinguishes between natural persons (individual) and legal entities (trust, corporation, partnership, association, estate). Drives downstream processing rules for identity verification, tax reporting, and regulatory compliance.']
  pep_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party is a Politically Exposed Person (PEP) - an individual who holds or has held a prominent public position (government official, senior executive of state-owned enterprise, etc.). True indicates PEP status requiring enhanced due diligence (EDD). False indicates non-PEP status.']
  residency_country varchar [note: 'Country of tax residency for the party. Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Determines tax reporting obligations, withholding requirements, and regulatory jurisdiction. May differ from citizenship_country for expatriates and foreign residents.']
  residency_state varchar [note: 'U.S. state or territory of primary residence for the party. Two-letter state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Determines state insurance department jurisdiction, premium tax situs, and state-specific regulatory requirements. Null for non-U.S. residents.']
  sar_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) has been filed for this party with FinCEN. True indicates SAR filing history requiring ongoing monitoring. False indicates no SAR filing history. SAR details are maintained in separate secure system per regulatory confidentiality requirements.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this party record (e.g., FAST, EXL, Sapiens, RGAX, Guidewire, Salesforce). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and source system traceability in multi-system environments.']
  source_system_party_code varchar [note: 'Unique identifier for the party in the source operational system. Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracking, and bidirectional synchronization between lakehouse and operational systems.']
  ssn varchar [note: 'Social Security Number for U.S. individual parties. Masked or tokenized in storage per PII compliance requirements. Used for tax reporting (1099-R, 1042-S), IRS TIN matching, and identity verification. Null for non-U.S. parties or entities using EIN/TIN.']
  stoli_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the party has been flagged for potential Stranger-Originated Life Insurance (STOLI) or investor-owned life insurance activity. True indicates STOLI concern requiring enhanced underwriting review and insurable interest verification. False indicates no STOLI concern.']
  suffix varchar [note: 'Generational or professional suffix appended to the individual party name (e.g., Jr., Sr., II, III, MD, Esq.). Null for non-individual party types. Supports accurate name matching and identity verification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Jr|Sr|II|III|IV|V|MD|PhD|Esq — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  tin varchar [note: 'Taxpayer Identification Number for the party. For individuals: SSN or ITIN. For entities: EIN (Employer Identification Number). Masked or tokenized in storage. Used for IRS tax reporting, 1099 issuance, FATCA/CRS compliance, and TIN matching validation.']
  tin_certification_status varchar [note: 'Status of IRS TIN certification and validation. Certified indicates successful IRS TIN matching. Pending indicates awaiting validation. Failed indicates TIN mismatch requiring B-notice processing. Exempt indicates party is exempt from TIN certification (e.g., foreign entities under treaty).']
  tin_type varchar [note: 'Type of taxpayer identification number. SSN for U.S. individuals, EIN for entities, ITIN for non-resident aliens, foreign_tax_id for non-U.S. tax identifiers. Drives tax reporting format and regulatory compliance requirements.']
  trust_ein varchar [note: 'Employer Identification Number (EIN) assigned to the trust by the IRS. Populated only when party_type is trust. Used for tax reporting (1099-R, 1042-S) and IRS TIN matching. Masked or tokenized in storage per PII compliance.']
  trust_establishment_date date [note: 'Date the trust was legally established or executed. Populated only when party_type is trust. Used for trust age calculations, grantor trust rules, and estate planning compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.']
  trust_name varchar [note: 'Legal name of the trust entity. Populated only when party_type is trust. Used for policy ownership records, beneficiary designations, and trust-owned life insurance (TOLI) or irrevocable life insurance trust (ILIT) administration.']
  trust_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the trust entity. ILIT (Irrevocable Life Insurance Trust) for life insurance ownership. Revocable_living for revocable living trusts. CRT (Charitable Remainder Trust), GRAT (Grantor Retained Annuity Trust), QPRT (Qualified Personal Residence Trust) for specialized estate planning trusts. Null for non-trust party types.']
  trustee_name varchar [note: 'Name of the current trustee(s) of the trust. Populated only when party_type is trust. May be individual or corporate trustee. Used for trust administration, correspondence, and fiduciary responsibility tracking.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this party record was last updated. Updated on every modification to track data freshness and change frequency. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']

  Note: 'Supertype master record representing any individual or legal entity that participates in the policyholder domain in any role (insured, owner, annuitant, beneficiary, guardian, attorney-in-fact, trustee, group sponsor). Stores core identity attributes shared across all roles: legal name, DOB (individuals), gender, SSN/TIN/EIN, citizenship, residency status, party type (individual, trust, corporation, association), and party status (active, deceased, incapacitated, sanctioned). For trust/legal entity parties: trust type (ILIT, revocable living trust, CRT, corporate entity), trustee names, grantor information, establishment date, state of formation, and termination provisions. Maintains identity credentials (SSN, TIN, EIN, passport, drivers license, state ID, ITIN, foreign tax IDs) with issuing authority, issue/expiry dates, document type, and masked/tokenized values for PII compliance. Tracks full party status history as embedded audit trail: prior status, new status, effective date, reason code, source system, and triggering analyst/process — covering transitions through active, deceased, incapacitated, legally incompetent, minor, expatriate, sanctioned/OFAC, and fraud-flagged states. All role-specific records (insured, contract_owner, annuitant, beneficiary) reference this party record via FK. SSOT for the unique person/entity identity — enabling de-duplication across roles where the same individual serves as both insured and owner. Supports IRS TIN matching, FATCA/CRS foreign account reporting, OFAC screening, HIPAA-compliant identity management, and ACORD Party model alignment.'

Table policyholder.insured_risk_assessment {
  insured_risk_assessment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for this insured-risk assessment association record. Primary key.']
  insured_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the insured individual being evaluated in this risk assessment']
  underwriting_risk_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the risk assessment evaluation record']
  assessment_date date [note: 'Date when this specific risk assessment was completed for this insured. Moved from risk_assessment because in joint life scenarios, different insureds may be assessed on different dates within the same overall assessment workflow.']
  assessment_outcome varchar [note: 'Final underwriting decision outcome for this specific insured within this assessment. In joint life policies, each insured may have different outcomes (one approved, one postponed).']
  assessment_status varchar [note: 'Current status of this insured-specific assessment relationship. Tracks whether this assessment is active, completed, or has been superseded by a subsequent reunderwriting.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this insured-risk assessment association record was created in the system.']
  financial_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Quantitative financial underwriting risk score for this specific insured within this assessment. Evaluates income replacement ratios, human life value, and financial justification specific to this insured.']
  insured_sequence_number varchar [note: 'Ordinal position of this insured within the assessment (1=primary insured, 2=secondary insured). Used in joint life and survivorship policies to distinguish assessment order and priority.']
  medical_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Quantitative medical underwriting risk score for this specific insured within this assessment. In joint life policies, each insured has their own medical risk profile and score.']
  overall_risk_classification varchar [note: 'Final holistic risk classification assigned to the applicant after evaluating all medical, financial, and compliance risk dimensions. Determines premium rate class. [Moved from risk_assessment: In joint life policies, each insured receives their own risk classification. The overall_risk_classification should be insured-specific and stored in the association as risk_classification.]']
  risk_classification varchar [note: 'Underwriting risk classification assigned to this specific insured within this assessment. In joint life policies, each insured receives their own classification. Maps to overall_risk_classification from risk_assessment but is insured-specific.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this insured-risk assessment association record was last updated.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the underwriting risk evaluation performed for a specific insured individual. It captures the many-to-many relationship between insureds and risk assessments, supporting scenarios where: (1) a single insured undergoes multiple risk assessments over their policy lifetime (initial underwriting, reunderwriting at policy changes, conversions, reinstatements), and (2) a single risk assessment evaluates multiple insureds simultaneously (joint life policies, survivorship policies, group certificate underwriting). Each record links one insured to one risk assessment with assessment-specific attributes that exist only in the context of this evaluation relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance underwriting, insureds undergo multiple risk assessments throughout their policy lifecycle (initial underwriting, reunderwriting at policy changes, conversions, reinstatements, coverage increases). Simultaneously, a single risk assessment can evaluate multiple insureds in joint life policies, survivorship policies, and group certificate underwriting scenarios. The business actively manages these assessment relationships, tracking insured-specific risk scores, classifications, and outcomes that vary by insured even within the same assessment event.'
}

Table policyholder.policyholder_training_completion {
  policyholder_training_completion_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for policyholder_training_completion']

  training_course_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the training course that was completed. References the master training course catalog record defining the curriculum, requirements, and regulatory mandate.']

  certificate_number varchar [note: 'Unique certificate identifier issued upon successful course completion. Used for regulatory audit trails and to verify completion with state Departments of Insurance. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  completion_date date [note: 'Date on which the party successfully completed the training course. Used to calculate expiration dates based on renewal frequency and to demonstrate timely compliance with regulatory training mandates. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  completion_method varchar [note: 'The specific delivery method used for this completion instance. May differ from the course\'s primary delivery_method if multiple modalities are offered.']
  completion_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this training completion record. COMPLETED indicates valid certification; EXPIRED indicates renewal is required; IN_PROGRESS indicates started but not finished; WAIVED indicates regulatory exemption granted.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this training completion record was created in the compliance system.']
  delivery_platform_used varchar [note: 'Name of the learning management system (LMS) or platform through which this specific completion was delivered. May differ from the course\'s primary delivery_platform if the party completed via an alternate channel.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date on which this training completion expires and the party must renew by retaking the course. Calculated from completion_date plus renewal_frequency_months from the training_course. Used to trigger renewal notifications and identify non-compliant parties. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  instructor_name varchar [note: 'Name of the instructor or facilitator who delivered the training, if applicable for instructor-led delivery methods. Null for self-paced online courses.']
  pass_fail_status varchar [note: 'Determination of whether the party met the minimum passing score threshold for the course. PASS indicates successful completion; FAIL indicates the party must retake the course. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric score achieved by the party on the course assessment, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 85.50 = 85.5%). Compared against passing_score_threshold from the training_course to determine pass/fail status. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this training completion record was last modified.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the completion event between party and training_course. It captures the regulatory-required record of compliance training completion for licensed agents, employees, and other parties subject to insurance regulatory training mandates. Each record links one party to one training_course with completion-specific attributes including score achieved, pass/fail determination, certificate issuance, and expiration tracking for renewal management. Serves as the operational system of record for demonstrating AML, HIPAA, suitability, ethics, and STOLI training compliance to state Departments of Insurance and federal regulators.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, individual parties (licensed agents, employees, trustees, guardians) are required to complete multiple compliance training courses over their tenure (AML, HIPAA, suitability, ethics, STOLI), and each training course is completed by many different parties across the organization. The business actively manages training completion as a distinct operational process with regulatory reporting obligations, tracking completion dates, scores, certificate numbers, and expiration dates for renewal management. Compliance teams query this relationship to identify parties with expired certifications, generate regulatory reports, and demonstrate training compliance to state Departments of Insurance.'
}

  premium_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which the rider premium is charged. Annual: once per year. Semi-annual: twice per year. Quarterly: four times per year. Monthly: twelve times per year. Single: one-time premium payment.']
  premium_mode varchar [note: 'Pattern of premium payments over the rider term. Level: constant premium. Increasing: premium increases over time. Decreasing: premium decreases over time. Flexible: premium varies based on policyholder elections or account performance.']
  rating_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'Additional premium percentage applied for substandard underwriting risk. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 25.00 means 25% additional premium). Null or zero for standard and preferred classes.']
  reinsurance_ceded_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the risk for this rider has been ceded to a reinsurer. True if reinsured, False if retained. Used for risk management and financial reporting.']
  rider_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the rider. Active: rider is in force and providing coverage. Suspended: temporarily not in force. Terminated: rider has been cancelled. Lapsed: rider has lapsed due to non-payment. Pending: rider application is under review. Matured: rider has reached its maturity date.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The name or identifier of the operational system from which this rider record originated (e.g., FAST, Sapiens LifePro, Oracle Insurance Policy Administration). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.']
  state_of_issue varchar [note: 'The two-letter US state code where the rider was issued. Determines applicable state insurance regulations and tax treatment.']
  surrender_charge decimal(18,2) [note: 'The penalty or charge applied if the rider is surrendered or terminated early. Common for riders with cash value or guaranteed benefits. Expressed in policy currency. Null if no surrender charge applies.']
  tax_qualified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the rider is part of a tax-qualified plan (e.g., 401k, IRA, 403b). True if tax-qualified, False otherwise. Affects tax treatment of premiums and benefits.']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date when this rider coverage was terminated, either due to rider expiry age, policy termination, or voluntary removal by policy owner.']
  underwriting_class varchar [note: 'The risk classification assigned to the insured for this rider during underwriting. Preferred: lowest risk. Standard: average risk. Substandard: higher risk with rated premium. Declined: rider application was rejected.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this rider record was last modified in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  version varchar [note: 'The version or edition of the rider form. Used to track changes in rider terms, benefits, or pricing over time. Important for compliance and benefit administration.']
  waiver_of_premium_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rider includes a waiver of premium benefit, meaning rider premiums are waived if the insured becomes disabled or meets other qualifying conditions. True if waiver applies, False otherwise.']
  withdrawal_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The maximum annual withdrawal percentage allowed under a GMWB (Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit) rider without penalty. Expressed as a percentage of the benefit base (e.g., 5.00 means 5% per year).']

  Note: 'Master record for every rider attached to a base policy. Covers all rider types: ADB (Accidental Death Benefit), AWL (Automatic Waiver of Premium), CAR (Company Action Rider), LTC (Long-Term Care), GMDB, GMIB, GMWB, GMAB, DI (Disability Income), child term, spouse term, and return-of-premium riders. Stores rider code, rider description, rider face amount, rider premium, rider effective date, rider expiry date, rider status, benefit trigger conditions, elimination period, benefit period, and ACORD rider form number. One policy may have multiple riders.'
}

Table policy.status_history {

  grace_period_length_days varchar [note: 'Number of days in the grace period. Varies by state jurisdiction and product type. Typically ranges from 30 to 61 days.']
  grace_period_notice_sent_date date [note: 'Date when the grace period notice was sent to the policyholder. Required by most state DOI regulations.']
  grace_period_start_date date [note: 'Date when the grace period began for this policy. Applicable when status transitions to grace_period due to premium non-payment. Null if transition is not grace-period-related.']
  grace_period_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the grace period. Active: grace period in effect. Expired: grace period ended without payment. Cured: premium paid during grace period. Waived: grace period waived by company action.']
  lapse_effective_date date [note: 'Date when the policy officially lapsed due to non-payment after grace period expiry. Null if policy did not lapse.']
  new_status varchar [note: 'The policy status after this transition. Captures the to-state in the status lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|pending|in_force|lapsed|grace_period|suspended|terminated|surrendered|matured|death_claim|free_look|rescinded|converted|reinstated|not_taken — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  overdue_premium_amount decimal(15,2) [note: 'Total premium amount that is overdue and triggered the grace period or lapse. Null if transition is not payment-related.']
  policy_number varchar [note: 'Business identifier of the policy contract. Denormalized for reporting convenience and audit trail completeness.']
  prior_status varchar [note: 'The policy status immediately before this transition occurred. Captures the from-state in the status lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|pending|in_force|lapsed|grace_period|suspended|terminated|surrendered|matured|death_claim|free_look|rescinded|converted|reinstated|not_taken — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  processed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when the status transition was recorded in the policy administration system. Captures the exact moment of system processing.']
  regulatory_reporting_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this status transition must be included in regulatory reporting to state DOI or NAIC. True if reportable, False otherwise.']
  reinstatement_eligibility_expiry_date date [note: 'Date after which the policy is no longer eligible for reinstatement. Typically 3-5 years after lapse date per policy terms and state regulations.']
  reversal_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this status transition was later reversed or corrected. True if reversed, False otherwise. Used for audit trail integrity.']
  reversal_reason varchar [note: 'Explanation of why this status transition was reversed. Null if no reversal occurred.']
  reversal_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this status transition was reversed. Null if no reversal occurred.']
  source_transaction_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the upstream transaction that triggered this status transition. Examples: billing transaction ID, claim ID, underwriting decision ID. Enables traceability to originating event.']
  source_transaction_type varchar [note: 'Type of transaction that triggered this status transition. Provides context for the originating business event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: premium_payment|claim_submission|underwriting_decision|policy_amendment|reinstatement_application|surrender_request|maturity_event|death_notification|free_look_cancellation|system_batch — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  state_jurisdiction_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter state code indicating the regulatory jurisdiction governing this status transition. Important for compliance with state-specific grace period and free-look requirements.']
  transition_approval_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this status transition required supervisory or underwriting approval. True if approval was required, False otherwise.']
  transition_approved_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the status transition was approved. Null if no approval was required or if pending approval.']
  transition_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating why the status transition occurred. Examples: lapse for non-payment, reinstatement, surrender, death claim, maturity, conversion, rescission, free-look cancellation, grace period expiry, premium payment received, underwriting approval, policy issued.']
  transition_reason_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative explanation of the reason for the status transition. Provides business context beyond the reason code.']
  transition_triggered_by_system varchar [note: 'Name of the system that triggered the status transition. Examples: Policy Administration System, Billing System, Claims System, Underwriting Workbench, Manual Entry.']
  transition_triggered_by_user_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the user who initiated the status transition. Denormalized for audit trail completeness. Null if transition was system-automated.']

  Note: 'Immutable audit log of every policy status transition throughout the full policy lifecycle. SSOT for grace period tracking, free-look period management, and all status-driven compliance events. Records prior status, new status, transition reason code (lapse for non-payment, reinstatement, surrender, death claim, maturity, conversion, rescission, free-look cancellation, grace period expiry), effective date, processed timestamp, grace period start date, grace period end date, grace period length in days, overdue premium amount, grace period notice sent date, grace period status (active, expired, cured), lapse effective date (if grace expired without payment), free-look period start date, free-look period end date, free-look cancellation request date, free-look refund amount, free-look refund method, free-look refund disbursement date, reinstatement eligibility expiry date, and the system or user that triggered the transition. Supports regulatory reporting, lapse studies, state DOI grace period compliance (30-61 day minimums), free-look cancellation processing (10-30 day state DOI requirements), and actuarial experience analysis.'
}
