  tax_qualified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the annuity contract funding this payout schedule is a tax-qualified contract (e.g., IRA, 403(b), 401(a)) or a non-qualified contract. Determines IRC Section 72 tax treatment and exclusion ratio applicability.']

  payment_reversal_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this payment record represents a reversal or correction of a previously issued payment. True = this is a reversal/correction entry; False = original payment. Used for reconciliation and audit trail integrity.']
  payment_sequence_number varchar [note: 'Sequential ordinal number of this payment within the annuity contract\'s payout schedule (e.g., 1 = first payment, 24 = 24th monthly payment). Used for payment tracking, duration analysis, and identifying the position within the payout phase.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the benefit payment. \'scheduled\' = payment queued for future disbursement; \'issued\' = payment sent to payee; \'cleared\' = confirmed received by payee\'s financial institution; \'returned\' = payment rejected or returned by bank; \'stopped\' = payment halted before issuance; \'voided\' = payment cancelled and reversed.']
  payment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the benefit payment by its contractual or regulatory basis. Distinguishes annuitization income, Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) payments, Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) income, systematic withdrawals, Required Minimum Distributions (RMD), death benefit payouts, partial surrenders, and lump-sum settlements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: annuitization|gmwb_withdrawal|gmib_income|systematic_withdrawal|rmd_distribution|death_benefit|surrender_partial|lump_sum — promote to reference product]']
  payout_phase varchar [note: 'Indicates the contractual phase of the annuity contract at the time of this payment. \'accumulation\' = contract still in growth phase (e.g., systematic withdrawal); \'annuitization\' = contract has been annuitized and is in income phase; \'payout\' = living benefit payout phase; \'surrender\' = payment associated with full or partial surrender.']
  reportable_amount_1099r decimal(18,2) [note: 'The gross distribution amount to be reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 1 for this payment. For most payments equals gross_payment_amount; may differ for corrected or adjusted payments. Drives annual 1099-R tax form generation for the annuitant.']
  rmd_tax_year varchar [note: 'The IRS tax year (four-digit year) to which this RMD payment is attributed. Populated only when is_rmd_payment is True. Used for RMD compliance tracking and IRS reporting under IRC Section 401(a)(9).']
  scheduled_payment_date date [note: 'The contractually scheduled date on which the benefit payment was originally planned to be disbursed per the annuity payout schedule. Used to identify late payments and measure payment timeliness against contractual obligations.']
  state_tax_withheld_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of state income tax withheld from the gross benefit payment per the annuitant\'s state withholding election or applicable state mandatory withholding rules. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 14.']
  state_withholding_state_code varchar [note: 'Two-letter USPS state code identifying the state for which state income tax was withheld on this payment. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 15. Required for multi-state tax reporting compliance.']
  surrender_charge_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Contractual deferred sales charge (surrender charge) deducted from the payment amount when a withdrawal or surrender occurs within the surrender charge period defined in the annuity contract. Reduces the net payment to the annuitant.']
  tax_year varchar [note: 'The IRS tax year (four-digit calendar year) to which this benefit payment is attributed for 1099-R reporting purposes. Typically the year in which the payment_date falls, but may differ for year-end payments processed in January.']
  taxable_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the gross payment amount that is subject to ordinary income tax. For non-qualified contracts, this equals gross payment minus the exclusion ratio amount. For qualified contracts, typically equals the full gross payment. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 2a.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this benefit payment record was last modified in the source system. Used for incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail maintenance.']
  withholding_election_type varchar [note: 'Indicates the basis for federal tax withholding on this payment. \'elected\' = annuitant submitted a W-4P withholding election; \'mandatory\' = mandatory withholding applies (e.g., eligible rollover distributions); \'waived\' = annuitant elected to waive withholding where permitted under IRC Section 3405.']

  Note: 'Records each periodic income payment disbursed to an annuitant or beneficiary under an annuity payout schedule or living benefit claim. Captures payment date, scheduled payment amount, actual payment amount, federal and state tax withholding, net payment amount, payment method (ACH, check, wire), payment status, 1099-R reportable amount, exclusion ratio applied (for non-qualified contracts under IRC Section 72), and cumulative investment in contract recovered. Sourced from Sapiens Annuity payment processing module.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed_annuity|variable_annuity|fia|whole_life|universal_life|term_life — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]']

  rider_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the rider or benefit attachment.   rider_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the rider product design, corresponding to a specific generation of benefit terms, charge rates, and eligibility rules.   rollup_period_years varchar [note: 'Maximum number of years during which the guaranteed rollup rate is applied to grow the benefit base. After this period, the benefit base stops rolling up but the rider may remain in force. Null if rollup continues indefinitely until benefit election.']
  rollup_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'Annual guaranteed growth rate applied to the benefit base during the accumulation (deferral) phase, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.060000 = 6.00% per annum).   source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this rider benefit record was sourced (e.g., \'SAPIENS_ANNUITY\', \'FAST_ANNUITY\'). Used for data lineage tracking, ETL reconciliation, and Silver layer audit in the Databricks Lakehouse.']
  source_system_rider_reference varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this rider record in the originating operational system of record (e.g., Sapiens Annuity internal rider ID). Enables back-referencing to the source system for reconciliation, issue resolution, and ETL lineage tracing.']
  state_availability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of US state codes (2-letter USPS abbreviations) in which this rider form has been approved and is available for sale.   step_up_provision boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this rider includes an automatic or optional step-up (ratchet) provision that locks in market gains by resetting the benefit base to the current account value if the account value exceeds the benefit base on a specified anniversary date. True = step-up provision exists; False = no step-up.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the rider was or is scheduled to be terminated. Null if the rider is still in force. Populated upon rider lapse, voluntary removal, contract surrender, annuitization, or death claim settlement.']

  is_1035_exchange boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this payment represents proceeds received from a tax-free 1035 exchange (IRC Section 1035 — Tax-Free Insurance Policy Exchange). When true, additional 1035 exchange tracking fields apply and the payment requires IRS Form 1035 documentation.']
  is_unscheduled boolean [note: 'Flag indicating whether this payment is an unscheduled additional premium contribution not tied to the modal premium schedule. Common for flexible premium deferred annuities where owners make ad-hoc contributions.']
  nigo_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the NIGO deficiency reason when nigo_status is \'nigo_pending\' or \'nigo_rejected\'. Examples: missing suitability form, missing signature, missing source of funds documentation, incomplete beneficiary designation.']
  nigo_resolution_date date [note: 'The date on which the NIGO deficiency was resolved and the payment was cleared for application to the annuity contract. Null if nigo_status is \'good_order\' or \'nigo_pending\'.']
  nigo_status varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the payment application was received in good order or flagged as Not In Good Order (NIGO). \'good_order\' = all required documentation and information received; \'nigo_pending\' = deficiency identified, awaiting resolution; \'nigo_resolved\' = NIGO deficiency resolved and payment applied; \'nigo_rejected\' = NIGO could not be resolved and payment returned.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The business date on which the premium payment was received by the company. This is the principal real-world event date used for contract crediting, cost basis tracking, and IRC Section 72 tax reporting.']
  payment_frequency varchar [note: 'The modal frequency at which this payment is made under the contract\'s premium schedule. \'single\' = one-time single premium; \'annual\' = annual mode; \'semi_annual\' = semi-annual mode; \'quarterly\' = quarterly mode; \'monthly\' = monthly mode. Drives premium billing schedule and APE (Annual Premium Equivalent) calculations.']
  payment_number varchar [note: 'Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this premium payment transaction by the Annuity Administration Platform (e.g., Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity). Used for reconciliation, customer correspondence, and audit trails.']
  payment_source varchar [note: 'The remittance instrument or channel through which the premium payment funds were received. Drives reconciliation workflows and AML monitoring thresholds. \'check\' = personal or cashier\'s check; \'wire\' = wire transfer; \'ach\' = ACH electronic funds transfer; \'1035_exchange\' = proceeds from a 1035 tax-free exchange; \'rollover_check\' = qualified plan rollover check; \'credit_card\' = credit card payment.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the premium payment transaction. \'pending\' = received but not yet applied to contract AV; \'posted\' = successfully applied; \'reversed\' = payment reversed after posting; \'returned\' = payment returned by financial institution (e.g., NSF); \'suspended\' = held in suspense pending NIGO resolution; \'rejected\' = rejected and not applied.']
  payment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the premium payment by its business purpose. \'initial_single_premium\' = first and only premium for SPIAs or single-premium deferred annuities; \'subsequent_flexible_premium\' = additional premium for flexible premium deferred annuities; \'1035_exchange_proceeds\' = funds received via a tax-free 1035 exchange; \'rollover\' = qualified plan rollover (IRA, 401k); \'transfer\' = direct trustee-to-trustee transfer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_single_premium|subsequent_flexible_premium|1035_exchange_proceeds|rollover|transfer|direct_transfer|trustee_transfer — promote to reference product]']
  payor_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the individual or entity that remitted the premium payment. May differ from the contract owner when a third party remits payment. Required for AML/KYC source-of-funds verification and IRS tax reporting.']
  payor_relationship_to_owner varchar [note: 'Describes the relationship of the payor to the annuity contract owner when the payor is not the owner. Used for AML third-party payment monitoring and suitability review. \'self\' = owner is the payor. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self|spouse|parent|child|trust|employer|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  premium_load_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Dollar amount of premium load or front-end charge deducted from the gross payment before crediting to the contract AV. Represents the difference between gross_payment_amount and applied_amount attributable to premium loads.']
  reversal_date date [note: 'The date on which the payment reversal was processed and the AV adjustment was made to the annuity contract. Null for non-reversed payments.']
  reversal_reason varchar [note: 'Description of the reason for payment reversal when payment_status is \'reversed\'. Examples: duplicate payment, incorrect contract application, owner request, NSF return. Null for non-reversed payments.']
  scheduled_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The contractually scheduled premium amount for this payment period as defined in the modal premium schedule. Compared against gross_payment_amount to identify over-payments, under-payments, or unscheduled additional premiums.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this payment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. \'SAPIENS_ANNUITY\' = Sapiens Annuity platform; \'FAST_ANNUITY\' = FAST Annuity platform; \'POLICY_ADMIN\' = Policy Administration System; \'MANUAL\' = manually entered correction.']
  source_transaction_reference varchar [note: 'The native transaction identifier assigned by the originating operational system (e.g., Sapiens Annuity or FAST Annuity) for this payment record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between Silver Layer and source systems, and audit trail.']
  tax_qualification_code varchar [note: 'Indicates the tax qualification status of the premium payment, which determines cost basis treatment and tax reporting obligations under IRC Section 72. \'qualified\' = pre-tax qualified plan funds (IRA, 401k, 403b); \'non_qualified\' = after-tax funds; \'roth_ira\' = Roth IRA funds; \'sep_ira\' = SEP-IRA; \'simple_ira\' = SIMPLE IRA; \'403b\' = 403(b) tax-sheltered annuity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: qualified|non_qualified|roth_ira|sep_ira|simple_ira|403b|457b|pension — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this payment record was last modified in the annuity administration system. Tracks status changes, NIGO resolution updates, and corrections.']
  wire_reference_number varchar [note: 'The wire transfer reference or IMAD (Input Message Accountability Data) number assigned by the sending financial institution when payment_source is \'wire\'. Used for Fedwire reconciliation and AML source-of-funds documentation.']

  Note: 'Records all premium and purchase payment transactions applied to annuity contracts, including initial single premiums, subsequent flexible premiums (for flexible premium deferred annuities), and 1035 exchange proceeds received. Captures payment date, payment amount, payment source (check, wire, ACH, 1035 exchange), tax qualification of payment (qualified/non-qualified), cost basis contribution, modal premium schedule reference, and NIGO resolution status. Distinct from billing domain premium billing records; this is the annuity-specific payment receipt ledger.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5|6|7|8|9|A|B|C|D|E|F|G|H|J|K|L|M|N|P|Q|R|S|T|U|W — promote to reference product]']

Represents the total premiums paid less any amounts previously received tax-free. This is the primary cost basis figure used for exclusion ratio calculations and 1099-R reporting.']

  ledger_effective_date date [note: 'The date on which this cost basis ledger record became effective, typically the contract issue date or the date of a 1035 exchange that established the initial investment in contract.']
  ledger_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the cost basis ledger record.   mec_determination_date date [note: 'The date on which the contract was determined to be or not to be a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC). Null if MEC determination has not been triggered.']
  mec_status boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the annuity contract has been classified as a Modified Endowment Contract (MEC) under IRC Section 7702A. MEC status affects the tax treatment of distributions, subjecting them to LIFO (last-in, first-out) income recognition and potential 10% penalty tax.']
  nontaxable_distributions_received decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative amount of distributions that have been treated as non-taxable return of cost basis (investment in contract) under the IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio. Reduces the remaining investment in contract.']
  owner_age_at_annuity_start varchar [note: 'The age of the contract owner at the annuity start date, used for IRS actuarial table lookups (Tables V, VI, VII in IRS Publication 939) to determine the expected return multiple for the exclusion ratio calculation.']
  partial_surrender_basis_adjustment decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative reduction to the investment in contract resulting from partial surrenders or withdrawals that returned cost basis to the owner. Tracks the pro-rata cost basis recovery applied to partial surrenders of non-qualified annuities.']
  payout_option varchar [note: 'The annuitization payout option elected by the contract owner. Determines the expected return calculation method and applicable IRS actuarial table (Table V, VI, or VII) for the exclusion ratio.']
  periodic_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The fixed periodic payment amount received under the annuitization option. Used to calculate the annual exclusion amount (periodic_payment_amount multiplied by payment frequency multiplied by exclusion_ratio).']
  remaining_investment_in_contract decimal(18,2) [note: 'The remaining unrecovered cost basis in the annuity contract as of the ledger_as_of_date. Calculated as investment_in_contract minus nontaxable_distributions_received. Drives the exclusion ratio for future annuity payments.']
  source_contract_number varchar [note: 'The contract number of the prior annuity or life insurance contract from which cost basis was received via a 1035 exchange. Null if no 1035 exchange occurred.']
  tax_year varchar [note: 'The calendar tax year for which this cost basis ledger snapshot is prepared. Used for annual 1099-R tax reporting and IRS compliance. Format: YYYY (e.g., 2024).']
  taxable_distributions_received decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative amount of distributions that have been treated as taxable income (earnings above cost basis) under IRC Section 72. Reported on IRS Form 1099-R Box 2a.']
  total_distributions_received decimal(18,2) [note: 'Cumulative gross distributions (withdrawals, partial surrenders, annuity payments) received from the contract since inception. Used in conjunction with the exclusion ratio to determine the taxable and non-taxable portions of each distribution.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this cost basis ledger record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.']

  Note: 'Tracks the investment in contract (cost basis) for each annuity contract for IRC Section 72 tax reporting purposes. Captures cumulative after-tax premiums paid, cost basis adjustments from 1035 exchanges, partial surrender cost basis recovery, exclusion ratio calculation inputs, total distributions received, remaining investment in contract, and MEC (Modified Endowment Contract) status flag. Essential for accurate 1099-R tax reporting and IRC Section 72 exclusion ratio calculations for non-qualified annuities.'

  renewal_election varchar [note: 'Indicates the policyholder\'s election for what happens at term end: AUTO_RENEW (automatically renew into same strategy at current rates), MANUAL_REALLOCATION (policyholder will make new allocation decision), EXPIRED (term completed and funds reallocated), TERMINATED (allocation ended before term completion)']
  term_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the crediting term for this allocation, marking the conclusion of the index measurement period and when interest credits are applied']
  term_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the crediting term for this allocation, marking the beginning of the index measurement period or fixed rate period']

  Note: 'This association product represents the allocation relationship between annuity contracts and crediting strategies. It captures the policyholder\'s election to allocate a portion of their account value to a specific crediting strategy for a defined term. Each record links one annuity_contract to one crediting_strategy with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation decision, including the percentage allocated, the term dates, and the specific rates locked in at election time.. Existence Justification: In fixed indexed annuity operations, contract owners actively allocate their account value across multiple crediting strategies simultaneously (e.g., 40% to S&P 500 annual point-to-point, 30% to Russell 2000 monthly average, 30% to fixed account). Each crediting strategy is elected by thousands of contracts. The allocation relationship is an operational business entity that contract administrators actively manage, with specific attributes like allocation percentage, term dates, and locked-in rates that belong to neither the contract nor the strategy alone.'
}

Table annuity.hedge_position {
  hedge_position_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for this hedge position record linking a benefit base to a derivative contract']
  benefit_base_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the guaranteed benefit base record for the living benefit rider being hedged']
  derivative_contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the derivative contract used to hedge this benefit base exposure']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this hedge position record was created in the risk management system']
  effectiveness_percentage decimal(8,4) [note: 'The most recent hedge effectiveness test result for this benefit base-derivative pairing, expressed as a percentage. Must be within 80-125% range for hedge accounting qualification under ASC 815']
  hedge_designation varchar [note: 'The accounting classification of this specific hedge relationship under GAAP, determining financial statement presentation and effectiveness testing requirements']
  hedge_ratio decimal(10,6) [note: 'The ratio of derivative notional to benefit base exposure being hedged, used to calculate hedge effectiveness and rebalancing thresholds']
  inception_date date [note: 'The date on which this benefit base was first hedged using this derivative contract, establishing the start of the hedge relationship']
  last_effectiveness_test_date date [note: 'The most recent date on which hedge effectiveness testing was performed for this benefit base-derivative pairing under ASC 815 requirements']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this hedge position record was most recently updated due to rebalancing, effectiveness testing, or status change']
  notional_allocated decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the derivative contract\'s total notional amount allocated to hedge this specific benefit base, enabling portfolio-level hedging efficiency']
  position_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this hedge position indicating whether the hedge relationship is actively managed or has been terminated']
  rebalancing_frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency at which this hedge position is reviewed and rebalanced to maintain target hedge ratio. Event-Driven indicates rebalancing triggered by benefit base step-ups or excess withdrawals']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date on which this hedge relationship was terminated due to derivative maturity, benefit base expiry, or rebalancing decision']

  Note: 'This association product represents the hedging relationship between a living benefit rider\'s benefit base and derivative contracts used to offset market risk exposure. Each record links one benefit base to one derivative contract and captures hedge-specific attributes including notional allocation, hedge ratio, effectiveness testing results, and rebalancing parameters. Critical for ALM risk management, ASC 815 hedge accounting compliance, and actuarial reserve adequacy under LDTI.. Existence Justification: In life insurance ALM operations, living benefit riders (GMWB/GMIB/GMAB) expose the insurer to market risk that must be hedged using derivative contracts. A single benefit base is typically hedged using multiple derivative instruments (e.g., equity options for equity exposure, interest rate swaps for rate exposure, variance swaps for volatility) to achieve comprehensive risk coverage. Conversely, a single derivative contract often hedges multiple benefit bases across different contracts to achieve portfolio-level efficiency and reduce transaction costs. Risk managers actively manage these hedge positions, tracking notional allocation, hedge ratios, effectiveness testing results per ASC 815, and rebalancing frequency for each benefit base-derivative pairing.'
}

Table annuity.rider_election {

  election_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this rider election: ACTIVE (rider is in force), TERMINATED (rider coverage ended), SUSPENDED (temporarily inactive), PENDING (elected but not yet effective). Identified in detection phase as benefit_election_status.']
  gmab_benefit_base decimal(18,2) [note: 'The Guaranteed Minimum Accumulation Benefit (GMAB) benefit base — the guaranteed minimum account value at the end of the accumulation period, regardless of market performance. Null if no GMAB rider is attached. [Moved from annuity_contract: This attribute represents the benefit base for a GMAB rider election, which is relationship-specific data. Different GMAB riders elected on the same contract could have different benefit bases. Should be modeled as benefit_base_amount in rider_election where rider_type = \'GMAB\'.]']
  gmdb_type varchar [note: 'The type of Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit (GMDB) rider attached to this contract: RETURN_OF_PREMIUM (death benefit = at least total premiums paid), ANNUAL_STEP_UP (locks in highest anniversary value), ROLL_UP (grows at a guaranteed rate), GREATER_OF (highest of multiple methods), or NONE (no GMDB rider, standard death benefit = account value). Drives death benefit calculations. [Moved from annuity_contract: This attribute represents the type of GMDB rider elected on the contract. Since a contract can have multiple death benefit riders (base GMDB plus optional ADB riders), this is relationship-specific data that belongs in rider_election, not on the contract master record.]']
  gmib_benefit_base decimal(18,2) [note: 'The Guaranteed Minimum Income Benefit (GMIB) benefit base — the notional amount used to calculate the minimum annuitization income under the GMIB rider, regardless of actual account value performance. Null if no GMIB rider is attached. [Moved from annuity_contract: This attribute represents the benefit base for a GMIB rider election, which is relationship-specific data. Different GMIB riders elected on the same contract could have different benefit bases. Should be modeled as benefit_base_amount in rider_election where rider_type = \'GMIB\'.]']
  gmwb_benefit_base decimal(18,2) [note: 'The Guaranteed Minimum Withdrawal Benefit (GMWB) benefit base — the notional amount used to calculate the guaranteed annual withdrawal amount under the GMWB rider. May differ from the Account Value due to roll-up credits, step-ups, and prior withdrawals. Null if no GMWB rider is attached. [Moved from annuity_contract: This attribute represents the benefit base for a GMWB rider election, which is relationship-specific data. Different GMWB riders elected on the same contract could have different benefit bases. Should be modeled as benefit_base_amount in rider_election where rider_type = \'GMWB\'.]']
  termination_date date [note: 'The date on which the rider coverage terminated, either due to contract maturity, rider expiry age, voluntary cancellation, or contract lapse. Null for active riders. Identified in detection phase relationship data.']
  underwriting_class varchar [note: 'The underwriting classification assigned to this rider election, which affects charge_rate and benefit eligibility.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this rider election record was last updated.']
  waiting_period_years varchar [note: 'The number of years from election_date before certain rider benefits become available, commonly used for LTC acceleration riders and guaranteed insurability riders. Identified in detection phase relationship data.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the election of optional or mandatory riders on annuity contracts. Each record captures the business event when a specific rider is attached to a specific annuity contract, including the election terms, charge rates, benefit bases, and lifecycle status. This is a core operational entity in annuity administration, as riders fundamentally alter the contract\'s benefits, pricing, and tax treatment.. Existence Justification: In life insurance and annuity operations, contracts routinely elect multiple riders (GMWB, GMDB, LTC acceleration, return of premium), and each rider definition is elected on thousands of contracts across the book of business. Rider elections are actively managed operational entities with their own lifecycle: they are added at issue or post-issue, have effective dates and termination dates, carry election-specific charge rates and benefit bases, and can be suspended or terminated independently of the base contract. This is a core operational M:N relationship.'
}

Table annuity.contract_remediation {
  contract_remediation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each contract remediation record in the compliance tracking system']
  annuity_contract_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the annuity contract being remediated under this plan']

  identification_date date [note: 'The date on which this specific contract was identified as being affected by the compliance deficiency and included in the remediation plan scope.']
  remediation_completion_date date [note: 'The date on which all remediation actions for this specific contract under this plan were completed, including restitution payment and any required contract corrections or notifications.']
  remediation_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes documenting contract-specific remediation details, exceptions, owner communications, or special handling requirements for this contract under this plan.']
  restitution_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The calculated restitution amount owed to the contract owner or annuitant as a result of the compliance deficiency identified in the remediation plan. May include interest, fees, or other compensation as required by the regulatory framework.']
  restitution_method varchar [note: 'The method by which restitution was provided to the contract owner for this remediation.']
  restitution_payment_date date [note: 'The date on which the restitution amount was paid to the contract owner or credited to the contract account value.']
  validation_outcome varchar [note: 'Result of the validation testing or review confirming whether the remediation actions for this specific contract were effective and met regulatory requirements. Tracks contract-level validation separate from plan-level validation.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the remediation relationship between annuity contracts and compliance remediation plans. It captures the specific remediation actions, restitution amounts, and completion status for each contract affected by a compliance finding or regulatory exam. Each record links one annuity_contract to one remediation_plan with attributes that exist only in the context of this remediation relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance compliance operations, a single remediation plan (arising from a regulatory exam or audit finding) typically affects multiple annuity contracts that share the same deficiency pattern (e.g., improper fee calculations, disclosure violations, suitability issues). Conversely, a single annuity contract can be subject to multiple remediation plans over its lifetime, arising from different exams, findings, or compliance frameworks. The business actively manages contract-level remediation tracking with specific restitution amounts, completion dates, and validation outcomes for each contract-plan combination.'
}

  reinsurance_treaty_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent reinsurance treaty to which this schedule belongs. A single treaty may have multiple schedules covering different plan codes or underwriting classes.']
  allowance_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of reinsurance premium returned to the ceding company as an expense allowance under coinsurance arrangements, representing a share of acquisition costs (DAC) and ongoing maintenance expenses.']
  attained_age_basis boolean [note: 'Indicates whether YRT rates in this schedule are applied on an attained age basis (True) or issue age basis (False). Attained age basis recalculates the rate each policy anniversary based on the insured\'s current age.']
  automatic_binding_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum face amount or NAR up to which the reinsurer is automatically bound to accept cessions without individual underwriting review. Risks exceeding this limit require facultative placement.']
  cession_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether cessions under this schedule are automatic (bound by treaty terms without individual underwriting), facultative (individually negotiated per risk), or facultative-obligatory (reinsurer must accept if ceding company offers).']
  coinsurance_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage of the policy\'s face amount or account value ceded to the reinsurer under a coinsurance or modified coinsurance arrangement. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Null for YRT schedule types.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this treaty schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and NAIC examination standards.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the YRT rates, flat extra premiums, and retention limits are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD). Required for multi-currency treaty arrangements with international reinsurers.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which this treaty schedule becomes binding and applicable for NAR-based cession calculations and premium determination. Aligns with treaty effective date or amendment effective date.']
  experience_refund_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this schedule is subject to an experience refund (profit-sharing) arrangement where the reinsurer returns a portion of profits to the ceding company if actual mortality experience is favorable relative to expected.']
  experience_refund_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Maximum percentage of reinsurance profit that may be returned to the ceding company under the experience refund arrangement. Null if experience_refund_eligible is False.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which this treaty schedule ceases to be applicable. Null for open-ended schedules. When populated, a superseding schedule should exist with an effective date equal to or following this date.']
  flat_extra_duration_years varchar [note: 'Number of policy years for which the flat extra premium applies. After this duration, the flat extra expires and only the standard YRT rate applies. Null if the flat extra is permanent.']
  flat_extra_premium decimal(18,6) [note: 'Additional reinsurance premium per $1,000 of NAR charged for substandard risks with specific hazards (e.g., aviation, occupation) that cannot be fully captured by table ratings. Applied in addition to the standard YRT rate.']
  gender varchar [note: 'Gender classification for which this schedule\'s rates apply. Unisex rates are used in jurisdictions prohibiting gender-based pricing; composite rates blend male and female experience.']
  issue_age_max varchar [note: 'Maximum insured issue age (in whole years) for which this schedule\'s rates and terms apply. Defines the upper bound of the age band for YRT rate lookup and cession eligibility.']
  issue_age_min varchar [note: 'Minimum insured issue age (in whole years) for which this schedule\'s rates and terms apply. Defines the lower bound of the age band for YRT rate lookup and cession eligibility.']
  mortality_improvement_scale varchar [note: 'Actuarial mortality improvement projection scale applied to the base mortality table for this schedule (e.g., Scale AA, Scale G2, Scale MP-2021). Used in PBR (Principle-Based Reserving) and cash flow projection models.']
  mortality_table_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the underlying mortality table used to derive the YRT rates in this schedule (e.g., 2001 CSO, 2017 CSO, 1980 CSO). Critical for actuarial valuation, PBR compliance, and reserve calculations.']
  policy_duration_max varchar [note: 'Maximum policy year (duration) for which this schedule\'s rates apply. Null if rates apply for the full remaining policy term beyond the minimum duration.']
  policy_duration_min varchar [note: 'Minimum policy year (duration) for which this schedule\'s rates apply. Enables duration-graded rate schedules where YRT rates vary by policy year in addition to attained age.']
  rate_basis varchar [note: 'Frequency basis on which the YRT rate per thousand is expressed. Annual rates are most common; modal factors may be applied for other frequencies in premium billing calculations.']
  rate_change_notice_days varchar [note: 'Number of days advance written notice the reinsurer must provide to the ceding company before implementing a rate change under this schedule. Governs treaty renegotiation timelines.']
  rate_guarantee_date date [note: 'Date through which the reinsurer guarantees the YRT rates or coinsurance terms in this schedule will not be changed. After this date, the reinsurer may renegotiate rates subject to treaty notice provisions.']
  recapture_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the ceding company has the right to recapture ceded risks under this schedule after a specified recapture waiting period. Recapture rights are a key treaty negotiation term affecting long-term reinsurance strategy.']
  recapture_waiting_period_years varchar [note: 'Minimum number of years from the original cession date before the ceding company may exercise recapture rights for risks ceded under this schedule. Null if recapture is not permitted.']
  reinsurance_basis varchar [note: 'The basis on which reinsurance premiums and cessions are calculated. NAR (Net Amount at Risk) is standard for YRT; face amount or account value may apply for coinsurance arrangements.']
  retention_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum dollar amount of net amount at risk or face amount that the ceding company retains per life before ceding the excess to the reinsurer under this schedule. Fundamental to automatic cession eligibility determination.']
  schedule_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the treaty schedule, including the specific plan codes, underwriting classes, or risk segments covered. Used for bordereaux reporting and treaty documentation purposes.']
  schedule_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this schedule as referenced in the reinsurance treaty document and bordereaux reporting. Used by reinsurers such as RGA and Swiss Re to identify the specific rate exhibit.']
  schedule_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the treaty schedule. Active schedules are used for current cession calculations; superseded schedules have been replaced by a newer version; terminated schedules are no longer in force.']
  schedule_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the reinsurance arrangement type governing this schedule. YRT (Yearly Renewable Term) schedules define per-thousand NAR rates; coinsurance schedules define cession percentages; modified coinsurance retains reserves with the ceding company. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: YRT|COINSURANCE|MODIFIED_COINSURANCE|STOP_LOSS|EXCESS_OF_LOSS — promote to reference product]']
  smoker_status varchar [note: 'Tobacco/smoker status classification for which this schedule\'s rates apply. Composite rates are used when smoker distinction is not separately rated under the treaty.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational reinsurance management system from which this schedule record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  table_rating varchar [note: 'Substandard mortality table rating applied to this schedule band, expressed as a standard table letter or percentage of standard mortality (e.g., Table B, Table D, 150%, 200%). Used to load YRT rates for substandard risks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard|table_b|table_c|table_d|table_e|table_f|table_h|table_j|table_l|table_p — promote to reference product]']
  table_rating_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Numeric multiplier representing the substandard table rating as a percentage of standard mortality (e.g., 1.5000 = 150% of standard = Table D). Used in actuarial valuation systems (MoSes, AXIS, Prophet) for reserve and premium calculations.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this treaty schedule record was last modified. Used for incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and change data capture tracking.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of this schedule, incremented each time the schedule is amended or repriced. Enables tracking of rate changes over the treaty lifecycle and supports actuarial experience studies.']
  yrt_rate_per_thousand decimal(18,6) [note: 'The YRT reinsurance premium rate expressed as a dollar amount per $1,000 of Net Amount at Risk (NAR) for the defined age/sex/risk class band. Used in NAR-based cession premium calculations. Null for non-YRT schedule types.']

  Note: 'Defines the detailed rate and retention schedule attached to a reinsurance treaty, including age/sex/risk class bands, YRT rates per thousand of NAR, coinsurance percentages, flat extra premiums, and substandard table ratings. Supports NAR-based cession calculations and actuarial pricing. Each treaty may have multiple schedules reflecting different plan codes or underwriting classes.'
}

  recapture_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this cession has been or is in the process of being recaptured by the ceding company. True when the ceding company has exercised its contractual right to reclaim the ceded risk from the reinsurer.']

  recapture_trigger varchar [note: 'The contractual or business event that triggered the recapture of this cession.   recaptured_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The face amount recaptured from the reinsurer when the ceding company exercises its recapture right. May be a partial recapture (less than the full ceded_face_amount) or full recapture.']
  reinsurance_premium_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer for this cession for the current billing period, calculated based on the NAR and applicable YRT rate or coinsurance premium rate. Core financial obligation of the cession.']
  retained_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the policy face amount retained by the ceding company (Life Insurance) after cession. Equals total face amount minus ceded_face_amount. Supports retention limit compliance monitoring and RBC optimization.']
  smoker_status varchar [note: 'Tobacco/smoking status of the insured, used in mortality rate table selection for YRT reinsurance premium calculation. Smoker and non-smoker rates differ significantly in life reinsurance pricing.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this cession record originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance, FAST Policy Administration). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL audit in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date on which the cession was terminated and reinsurance coverage ceased. Populated when cession_status is terminated or recaptured. Null for active cessions.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Business reason for the termination of this cession. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lapse|surrender|death|conversion|recapture|expiry|maturity — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this cession record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of each individual risk cession from Life Insurance to a reinsurer under an automatic or facultative treaty, including the full cession lifecycle through termination, recapture, and NAR-based premium calculation. Captures ceded policy reference, cession date, ceded face amount, NAR ceded, cession percentage, reinsurance plan code, treaty reference, cession type (automatic/facultative/recapture), cession status, termination date and reason (lapse, surrender, death, conversion), recapture details (recaptured amount, recapture penalty, recapture trigger, recapture effective date), and periodic NAR calculation attributes (death benefit, account value or reserve, NAR amount, calculation method, calculation date, effective period). This is the single source of truth for all ceded risk transactions, recapture events, and NAR calculations — the core operational transaction of the reinsurance domain.   adjustment_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The monetary adjustment applied to the standard calculated reinsurance premium for this billing period. Positive values indicate additional premium; negative values indicate credits. Null if no adjustment applies.']
  adjustment_reason varchar [note: 'The reason code for any adjustment to the reinsurance premium from the standard calculated amount. Captures retroactive corrections, rate table updates, NAR recalculations, or treaty amendments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_correction|nar_correction|retroactive_adjustment|treaty_amendment|data_correction|none — promote to reference product if additional reasons are needed]']
  allowance_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The ceding allowance or expense allowance credited back to the ceding company by the reinsurer, representing a portion of the gross premium returned to offset acquisition and administrative costs.']
  billing_mode varchar [note: 'The frequency at which reinsurance premiums are billed to the ceding company under the treaty terms. Determines the billing cycle and modal factor applied.']
  billing_period_end_date date [note: 'The last day of the billing period for which this reinsurance premium is charged. Defines the end of the coverage interval for the ceded risk in this billing cycle.']
  billing_period_start_date date [note: 'The first day of the billing period for which this reinsurance premium is charged. Defines the start of the coverage interval for the ceded risk in this billing cycle.']
  bordereaux_period varchar [note: 'The YYYY-MM formatted reporting period for which this premium is included in the bordereaux report submitted to the reinsurer. Supports monthly bordereaux reconciliation and reinsurer reporting obligations.']
  ceded_face_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the policy face amount (death benefit) ceded to the reinsurer under this cession. Used in coinsurance arrangements and for bordereaux reporting of ceded exposure.']
  ceded_nar decimal(18,2) [note: 'The Net Amount at Risk (NAR) ceded to the reinsurer as of the billing date. Represents the reinsurer\'s exposure — the difference between the ceded death benefit and the ceded reserve or account value. Used as the basis for YRT premium calculation.']
  ceded_reserve_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The actuarial reserve amount ceded to the reinsurer as of the billing period. Relevant for coinsurance and modified coinsurance (ModCo) treaties where reserves are shared. Supports RBC optimization and statutory reporting.']
  coinsurance_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage of the risk ceded to the reinsurer under a coinsurance or modified coinsurance treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Used to calculate the proportional share of premiums and reserves ceded.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this reinsurance premium record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this reinsurance premium record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency treaty arrangements.']
  due_date date [note: 'The contractual date by which the reinsurance premium must be remitted to the reinsurer per treaty terms. Used for overdue tracking and cash flow management.']
  experience_refund_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The experience refund or profit commission amount credited back to the ceding company based on favorable claims experience under the treaty. Applicable to treaties with experience refund provisions. Null if no experience refund applies for this period.']
  gross_premium_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The total gross reinsurance premium due for the billing period before any allowances, credits, or adjustments. Represents the full ceded premium obligation to the reinsurer.']
  insured_attained_age varchar [note: 'The attained age of the insured as of the billing period start date. Used to look up the applicable YRT rate from the treaty rate table and for actuarial experience studies.']
  insured_gender varchar [note: 'The gender of the insured used for YRT rate table lookup. Unisex rates apply in jurisdictions or products where gender-distinct pricing is not permitted.']
  is_retrocession boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this reinsurance premium relates to a retrocession arrangement (where the reinsurer further cedes risk to another reinsurer). True = retrocession; False = direct reinsurance cession.']
  modal_factor decimal(8,6) [note: 'The modal factor applied to convert the annual reinsurance premium to the billing frequency (e.g., monthly = 1/12 = 0.083333, quarterly = 0.25, semi-annual = 0.5, annual = 1.0). Reflects the billing mode agreed in the treaty.']
  net_premium_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The net reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer after deducting the ceding allowance from the gross premium. This is the actual cash amount remitted. Calculated as gross_premium_amount minus allowance_amount.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the reinsurance premium was remitted to the reinsurer. Null if payment has not yet been made. Used for reconciliation and bordereaux reporting.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the reinsurance premium billing record. Tracks whether the premium is pending remittance, has been paid, is overdue, has been waived, reversed due to correction, or is under dispute with the reinsurer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|paid|overdue|waived|reversed|disputed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]']
  policy_year varchar [note: 'The policy year in force at the time of this reinsurance premium billing. Used for YRT rate table lookup (rates often vary by policy duration) and for experience studies.']
  premium_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this reinsurance premium billing record, as assigned by the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA). Used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer remittance advice.']
  reinsurance_year varchar [note: 'The calendar year of the reinsurance premium billing. Used for annual bordereaux aggregation, statutory reporting, and reinsurance accounting period alignment.']
  reinsurer_policy_number varchar [note: 'The policy or certificate number assigned by the reinsurer to identify the ceded risk in their system. Used for bordereaux reconciliation and reinsurer correspondence.']
  remittance_reference varchar [note: 'The payment or wire transfer reference number associated with the actual remittance of this reinsurance premium to the reinsurer. Used for cash reconciliation and bordereaux matching.']
  risk_class varchar [note: 'The underwriting risk classification of the insured as applied to the reinsurance treaty rate table (e.g., preferred_plus, preferred, standard, substandard, table_rated). Determines the YRT rate applied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard|substandard|table_rated|smoker|non_smoker — promote to reference product]']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational source system from which this reinsurance premium record was extracted (e.g., SWISS_RE_IRIS, RGA_AURA). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the lakehouse Silver layer.']
  tax_withholding_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The amount of tax withheld from the reinsurance premium remittance, applicable for cross-border reinsurance arrangements subject to withholding tax treaties. Null for domestic arrangements with no withholding obligation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this reinsurance premium record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and Silver layer incremental processing.']
  yrt_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'The Yearly Renewable Term (YRT) rate per unit of Net Amount at Risk (NAR) applied to calculate the reinsurance premium for the billing period. Expressed as a rate per $1,000 of NAR. Sourced from the treaty rate table based on attained age, gender, and risk class.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of reinsurance premiums due and paid to reinsurers for ceded risk. Captures billing period, premium amount by cession, YRT rate applied, modal factor, ceded NAR at billing date, payment due date, payment status, and remittance reference. Supports bordereaux reporting and reinsurance premium accounting. Distinct from the billing domain which owns direct policyholder premiums.'
}

  recoverable_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The calculated amount Life Insurance expects to recover from the reinsurer, derived from the ceded claim amount multiplied by the recoverable percentage. This is the primary balance sheet asset for statutory reporting.']
  recoverable_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The contractual percentage of the ceded claim amount recoverable from the reinsurer as defined in the treaty terms. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9000 = 90%). Used in NAR-based cession calculations.']
  recoverable_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier assigned to this reinsurance recoverable record, used in bordereaux reporting and reinsurer correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance).']
  recoverable_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance recoverable. \'pending\' = identified but not yet submitted; \'submitted\' = sent to reinsurer awaiting payment; \'received\' = payment collected; \'disputed\' = reinsurer has contested the recoverable; \'closed\' = fully resolved; \'waived\' = recoverable forgone.']

This is the single source of truth for all reinsurance recoverables and reinsurance disputes. Critical for RBC optimization, statutory balance sheet reporting, and reinsurance operations/legal oversight of counterparty disputes.'

  nar_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Net Amount at Risk representing the reinsurer\'s exposure on this cession, calculated as the ceded death benefit less the policy\'s reserve or account value. Drives YRT reinsurance premium calculations.']

  smoker_status varchar [note: 'Tobacco use status of the insured as determined at underwriting. A key mortality risk factor that affects reinsurance premium rates and risk classification under YRT and coinsurance treaties.']

Table reinsurance.retrocession_treaty {
  retrocession_treaty_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the retrocession treaty record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for all downstream joins and lineage tracking.']
  legal_entity_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Retrocession treaties are executed by specific legal entities for regulatory reporting, RBC calculation, and capital management. Reinsurance teams track retrocession ownership by legal entity for stat']
  originating_reinsurer_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the ceding reinsurer (the party retroceding risk under this treaty). Enables end-to-end risk chain tracking from direct policy through reinsurance to retrocession.']
  primary_retrocession_reinsurer_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the retrocessionaire entity (the party accepting the retroceded risk). Links to the reinsurer/counterparty master record.']
  regulatory_obligation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_obligation. Business justification: Retrocession arrangements have specific regulatory disclosure requirements in statutory filings and may require prior approval in some jurisdictions. Regulatory obligations govern retrocession reporti']
  aggregate_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum total liability of the retrocessionaire under this treaty across all cessions in a defined period (typically annual). Once the aggregate limit is exhausted, additional losses are retained by the ceding reinsurer. Expressed in treaty currency.']
  allowance_rate decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of retrocession premium returned to the ceding reinsurer as a ceding allowance or expense reimbursement under coinsurance or modified coinsurance treaties. Covers Deferred Acquisition Cost (DAC) and expense loadings. Expressed as a decimal.']
  arbitration_clause_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the retrocession treaty contains an arbitration clause requiring disputes to be resolved through arbitration rather than litigation. Relevant for contract management and legal risk assessment.']
  authorized_reinsurer_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the retrocessionaire is an authorized (licensed) reinsurer in the applicable jurisdiction. Authorized status allows the ceding reinsurer to take full statutory credit for reinsurance without posting collateral.']
  automatic_binding_limit decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum face amount or NAR per individual life that may be automatically ceded under this retrocession treaty without facultative underwriting approval. Amounts exceeding this limit require facultative retrocession placement. Expressed in treaty currency.']
  bordereaux_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which bordereaux reports are submitted to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. Drives the reporting calendar in the Reinsurance Management System.']
  bordereaux_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the retrocession treaty requires periodic bordereaux reporting (detailed cession-level data submissions) to the retrocessionaire. Bordereaux are standard in proportional retrocession treaties.']
  ceded_layer_maximum decimal(18,2) [note: 'Upper bound (exhaustion point) of the risk layer ceded to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. Defines the maximum liability of the retrocessionaire per occurrence or in aggregate. Expressed in treaty currency.']
  ceded_layer_minimum decimal(18,2) [note: 'Lower bound of the risk layer ceded to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. For excess-of-loss treaties, this is the attachment point above which the retrocessionaire is liable. Expressed in treaty currency.']
  cession_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of eligible risk ceded to the retrocessionaire under quota-share or proportional retrocession arrangements. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 = 50%). Not applicable for excess-of-loss treaties.']
  collateral_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Current value of collateral posted by the retrocessionaire under this treaty, expressed in treaty currency. Monitored against outstanding retrocession recoverables for RBC credit qualification.']
  collateral_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the retrocessionaire is required to post collateral (e.g., letters of credit, trust funds) to support the retrocession obligations. Required for unauthorized retrocessionaires to qualify for RBC credit.']
  collateral_type varchar [note: 'Type of collateral posted by the retrocessionaire to secure retrocession obligations. Letter of credit and trust funds are the most common forms accepted by state regulators for unauthorized reinsurer credit.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the retrocession treaty record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts under this retrocession treaty are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency retrocession arrangements with international retrocessionaires such as Swiss Re or RGA.']
  cut_through_clause_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the retrocession treaty contains a cut-through clause allowing the original cedant (direct insurer) to claim directly against the retrocessionaire in the event of the intermediate reinsurer\'s insolvency.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the retrocession treaty becomes binding and new cessions may be placed. Used for premium calculation, reserve valuation, and regulatory reporting.']
  experience_refund_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this retrocession treaty includes an experience refund provision, whereby favorable mortality or morbidity experience results in a partial return of retrocession premium to the ceding reinsurer.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the retrocession treaty expires and no new cessions may be placed. Nullable for evergreen or continuous treaties. Critical for runoff management and reserve release timing.']
  facultative_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this treaty governs facultative retrocession (True) requiring individual risk submission and acceptance, or automatic retrocession (False) where eligible cessions are placed without prior approval.']
  funds_withheld_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this retrocession treaty operates on a funds-withheld basis, where the ceding reinsurer retains assets equal to the retrocession reserve rather than transferring them to the retrocessionaire. Relevant for modified coinsurance and funds-withheld coinsurance structures.']
  governing_law_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country/state code identifying the legal jurisdiction whose laws govern the retrocession treaty. Determines dispute resolution, regulatory oversight, and contract enforceability.']
  insolvency_clause_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the retrocession treaty contains an insolvency clause ensuring the retrocessionaire\'s obligations continue in the event of the ceding reinsurer\'s insolvency. Required under NAIC model regulations for credit for reinsurance.']
  modco_indicator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this retrocession treaty is structured as modified coinsurance (ModCo), where reserves are retained by the ceding reinsurer and a ModCo adjustment is paid to the retrocessionaire to reflect investment income on withheld reserves.']
  premium_payment_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which retrocession premiums are settled between the ceding reinsurer and the retrocessionaire. Drives bordereaux reporting schedules and cash flow management.']
  product_line varchar [note: 'Insurance product line covered by this retrocession treaty. Determines applicable mortality tables, reserve bases, and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: term_life|whole_life|universal_life|variable_life|annuity|disability_income|long_term_care|group_life — promote to reference product]']
  rbc_credit_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this retrocession treaty qualifies for Risk-Based Capital (RBC) credit under NAIC RBC framework, reducing the ceding reinsurer\'s required capital. Requires the retrocessionaire to meet NAIC authorized reinsurer standards or post collateral.']
  reinstatement_provision varchar [note: 'Describes the reinstatement terms for the aggregate limit after a loss event. \'None\' means no reinstatement; \'one_time\' allows a single reinstatement; \'unlimited\' allows unlimited reinstatements; \'paid\' requires premium payment for reinstatement.']
  retention_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Maximum Net Amount at Risk (NAR) or face amount retained by the ceding reinsurer before retroceding the excess to the retrocessionaire under this treaty. Expressed in treaty currency. Fundamental to NAR-based cession calculations and RBC capital optimization.']
  retrocession_premium_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'Rate applied to the ceded NAR or face amount to calculate the retrocession premium payable to the retrocessionaire. For YRT retrocession, expressed as rate per $1,000 of NAR. For coinsurance, expressed as a percentage of gross premium. Sourced from treaty rate schedules in the Reinsurance Management System.']
  retrocession_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the retrocession arrangement structure. Yearly Renewable Term (YRT) transfers mortality risk only; coinsurance transfers full risk including reserves; modified coinsurance (ModCo) retains reserves with the ceding party; funds-withheld is a variant of ModCo; quota share cedes a fixed percentage; excess-of-loss provides catastrophe protection above a retention limit.']
  retrocessionaire_rating varchar [note: 'Financial strength rating of the retrocessionaire as assigned by a recognized rating agency (e.g., A.M. Best, S&P, Moody\'s). Used for counterparty credit risk assessment and RBC credit eligibility determination.']
  retrocessionaire_rating_agency varchar [note: 'Name of the rating agency that issued the retrocessionaire\'s financial strength rating. Required for counterparty risk monitoring and regulatory credit for reinsurance qualification.']
  settlement_basis varchar [note: 'Basis on which retrocession premiums and claim recoverables are settled. Net settlement offsets premiums against recoverables; gross settlement processes each separately; cash call allows immediate recovery of large claims prior to scheduled settlement.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Actual date the retrocession treaty was terminated, if applicable. Distinct from expiry_date (scheduled end) — termination may occur early due to breach, mutual agreement, or regulatory action.']
  treaty_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive name of the retrocession treaty as agreed between the ceding reinsurer and retrocessionaire. Used in management reporting, bordereaux, and counterparty communications.']
  treaty_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the retrocession treaty, used in bordereaux reporting, settlement statements, and counterparty correspondence. Sourced from the Reinsurance Management System (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS or RGA AURA Reinsurance).']
  treaty_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the retrocession treaty. Active indicates the treaty is in force and accepting new cessions; runoff indicates no new cessions but existing obligations remain; terminated indicates all obligations are closed.']
  treaty_territory varchar [note: 'Geographic territory or jurisdictions in which the retrocession treaty applies. Defines the scope of eligible cessions by policyholder domicile or policy issuance state. May be a single country code, list of state codes, or \'worldwide\'.']
  treaty_version varchar [note: 'Version or amendment number of the retrocession treaty document, incremented when treaty terms are renegotiated or amended. Supports treaty amendment history and audit trail.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the retrocession treaty record was last modified. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance.']

  Note: 'Master and transactional record for retrocession arrangements where Life Insurance or its reinsurers further cede risk to retrocessionaires. Captures retrocession treaty terms (treaty number, retrocessionaire identity, retrocession type, ceded layers, effective dates, retention, and treaty status) and all individual retrocession cession records (originating cession reference, retrocession treaty reference, retrocessionaire, ceded amount, retrocession premium, effective date, cession status, and settlement tracking). This is the single source of truth for all retrocession arrangements and retrocession cession transactions. Supports multi-tier risk transfer modeling, end-to-end risk chain tracking from direct policy through reinsurance to retrocession, and RBC capital optimization strategies.'
}

  calculation_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes capturing any exceptions, manual overrides, or special circumstances associated with this NAR calculation, such as facultative underwriting adjustments or treaty amendment impacts.']

  calculation_run_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the NAR calculation was produced as part of a scheduled periodic run, an ad hoc request, a correction to a prior calculation, or a restatement for prior-period adjustments.']
  calculation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the NAR calculation record. Indicates whether the calculation is pending review, completed and approved, revised due to data corrections, voided, or in error state.']
  ceded_death_benefit_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The portion of the gross death benefit ceded to the reinsurer under the treaty. May differ from the gross death benefit when only a portion of the risk is ceded (e.g., automatic cession limits apply).']
  coi_rate_per_thousand decimal(10,6) [note: 'The YRT cost of insurance (COI) rate per $1,000 of Net Amount at Risk, sourced from the applicable treaty rate table based on attained age, gender, risk class, smoker status, and policy year. Directly used to compute the reinsurance premium.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this NAR calculation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this NAR calculation record (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency reinsurance treaties.']
  death_benefit_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The gross death benefit (DB) payable under the ceded policy as of the calculation date. Represents the total face amount including any riders such as Accidental Death Benefit (ADB) that are included in the cession.']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'The start date of the period for which this NAR calculation is effective. Used to determine the applicable YRT reinsurance premium billing period.']
  effective_to_date date [note: 'The end date of the period for which this NAR calculation is effective. Defines the close of the billing period for YRT reinsurance premium computation.']
  insured_age_at_calculation varchar [note: 'The attained age of the insured as of the calculation date. Used in YRT rate table lookups to determine the applicable cost of insurance (COI) rate per unit of NAR for reinsurance premium billing.']
  insured_gender varchar [note: 'The gender of the insured as used in the YRT rate table lookup. Unisex rates apply where state regulations prohibit gender-distinct pricing.']
  is_retrocession boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this NAR calculation pertains to a retrocession arrangement (i.e., the company is acting as a reinsurer ceding risk to a retrocessionaire). Distinguishes direct cession NAR from retrocession NAR in reporting.']
  nar_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The computed Net Amount at Risk (NAR), representing the difference between the ceded death benefit and the policy reserve or account value. This is the fundamental driver of YRT cost of insurance (COI) charges and reinsurance premium computation.']
  policy_reserve_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The actuarial reserve held for the ceded policy as of the valuation date. Used in the NAR calculation as the offset against the death benefit for traditional life products. Derived from the Actuarial Valuation System (e.g., AXIS, Prophet).']
  policy_year varchar [note: 'The policy year in force as of the calculation date. Used in YRT rate table lookups where rates vary by policy duration, and for actuarial experience studies.']
  product_type_code varchar [note: 'The type of life insurance product for the ceded policy. Determines the applicable NAR calculation method (e.g., account value offset for UL/IUL/VUL vs. interpolated reserve for WL/Term). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wl|ul|iul|vul|term|yrt|ltc|di — promote to reference product]']
  rate_table_version varchar [note: 'The version identifier of the YRT COI rate table applied in this NAR calculation. Ensures auditability and traceability of rate changes over time for actuarial and reinsurance premium reconciliation.']
  rbc_credit_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the reinsurance cession associated with this NAR calculation qualifies for Risk-Based Capital (RBC) credit under NAIC RBC rules. Supports RBC optimization reporting.']
  reinsurance_premium_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The reinsurance premium payable to the reinsurer for the effective period, computed as (NAR / 1,000) × COI rate per thousand. This is the primary output of the NAR calculation used in YRT premium billing and bordereaux reporting.']
  reinsurance_treaty_type varchar [note: 'The type of reinsurance treaty under which the NAR is calculated. YRT (Yearly Renewable Term) treaties use NAR directly for premium billing; coinsurance and modified coinsurance treaties use NAR for risk monitoring and RBC optimization.']
  risk_class varchar [note: 'The underwriting risk classification assigned to the insured, which determines the applicable YRT COI rate tier. Preferred classes attract lower reinsurance premiums; substandard or rated classes attract higher rates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preferred_plus|preferred|standard_plus|standard|substandard|rated — promote to reference product]']
  smoker_status varchar [note: 'Tobacco/smoker status of the insured as used in YRT rate table lookups. Smoker status significantly impacts the COI rate applied to the NAR for reinsurance premium computation.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational source system from which the NAR calculation data was originated (e.g., Swiss Re IRIS, RGA AURA Reinsurance, AXIS Actuarial Valuation System). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability.']
  treaty_year varchar [note: 'The year of the reinsurance treaty in force at the time of the NAR calculation. Used to identify the applicable rate table version when treaty terms are renegotiated periodically.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this NAR calculation record was last modified. Tracks revisions, corrections, and restatements for audit and compliance purposes.']
  valuation_date date [note: 'The actuarial valuation date as of which the policy reserve or account value is measured for NAR computation. Typically aligns with the beginning-of-year (BOY) or end-of-year (EOY) valuation cycle.']

  Note: 'Stores the periodic Net Amount at Risk (NAR) calculations for each ceded policy, which form the basis for YRT reinsurance premium billing. Captures calculation date, policy reference, death benefit, account value or reserve, NAR amount, calculation method, and effective period. NAR is the fundamental driver of YRT cost of insurance charges and reinsurance premium computation. Supports actuarial and reinsurance premium reconciliation.'
}
