  fyc_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Maximum percentage of First-Year Commission (FYC) that can be recaptured upon policy termination within the chargeback period. Represents the starting recapture rate at policy month 1 before any earned-down schedule is applied.']
  hierarchy_level_scope varchar [note: 'Specifies which levels of the agent commission hierarchy are subject to chargeback under this rule. \'writing_agent\' recaptures only from the producing agent; \'all_levels\' recaptures proportionally across the full hierarchy including GA, MGA, and BGA overrides.']
  installment_recapture_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the chargeback amount may be recovered from the agent in installments (deducted from future commission payments) rather than as a single lump-sum deduction. True = installment recovery is permitted under this rule.']
  max_chargeback_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Absolute dollar cap on the commission amount that can be recaptured under this rule for a single policy termination event. Prevents disproportionate recapture on high-face-value policies. NULL indicates no cap applies.']
  max_installment_months varchar [note: 'Maximum number of monthly commission payment cycles over which a chargeback amount may be recovered via installment deductions from future commissions. Applicable only when installment_recapture_allowed is True.']
  min_premium_threshold decimal(18,2) [note: 'Minimum annualized premium amount (in USD) that a policy must have paid before this chargeback rule is applicable. Policies with premiums below this threshold may be exempt from chargeback or subject to a different rule.']
  nbv_adjustment_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether chargebacks under this rule trigger a corresponding adjustment to the New Business Value (NBV) metric reported for the originating sales period. True = NBV is restated when chargeback is applied.']
  override_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Percentage of hierarchy override commissions (paid to GA, MGA, BGA levels) that are recaptured upon early policy termination. May differ from the writing agent FYC recapture rate.']
  policy_month_12_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 12 (end of first policy year). A key milestone in the chargeback schedule as FYC is typically fully earned after year one.']
  policy_month_1_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates in its first policy month. Typically the highest recapture rate in the schedule, often 100% of FYC paid.']
  policy_month_24_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 24. Represents the renewal commission recapture rate at the end of the second policy year.']
  policy_month_36_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 36. Typically the final step in a 36-month chargeback schedule; after this point no recapture applies.']
  policy_month_6_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Commission recapture percentage applicable when a policy terminates at or around policy month 6. Represents an intermediate point in the earned-down schedule.']
  product_type_code varchar [note: 'Insurance product type to which this chargeback rule applies (e.g., WL — Whole Life, UL — Universal Life, IUL — Indexed Universal Life, VUL — Variable Universal Life, Term, FIA — Fixed Indexed Annuity, SPIA — Single Premium Immediate Annuity, DI — Disability Income, LTC — Long-Term Care). Drives rule applicability during commission recapture processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|TERM|FIA|SPIA|DI|LTC|ANNUITY — promote to reference product]']
  recapture_method varchar [note: 'Method used to calculate the declining recapture percentage over the chargeback period. \'straight_line\' reduces recapture evenly each month; \'step_down\' applies tiered reductions at defined intervals; \'pro_rata\' is proportional to remaining period; \'flat\' applies a constant rate; \'custom_schedule\' references a separate recapture schedule table.']
  renewal_recapture_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'Maximum percentage of renewal commissions that can be recaptured upon early policy termination within the chargeback period. Renewal recapture schedules are typically less aggressive than FYC recapture.']
  rule_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this chargeback rule within the commission rules engine. Used in bordereaux reporting and commission statements to reference the applicable recapture schedule.']
  rule_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative explaining the business rationale, applicability conditions, and recapture mechanics of this chargeback rule. Supports compliance documentation and agent dispute resolution.']
  rule_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name describing the chargeback rule (e.g., \'Term Life 24-Month FYC Recapture — BGA Tier\'). Used in commission statements and agent communications.']
  rule_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the chargeback rule within the rules engine. \'active\' rules are applied to new policy terminations; \'superseded\' rules remain for historical recapture calculations on in-force policies.']
  source_rule_reference varchar [note: 'Native rule identifier or reference key from the originating commission management system (Sapiens Commission / Annocera). Enables traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer record and the operational system rule definition.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this chargeback rule was sourced (e.g., SAPIENS_COMMISSION, ANNOCERA). Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  state_jurisdiction varchar [note: 'Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) indicating the state jurisdiction for which this chargeback rule is applicable. NULL or \'ALL\' indicates the rule applies across all jurisdictions. State-specific rules may override national defaults per state Department of Insurance requirements.']
  termination_reason_scope varchar [note: 'Defines which policy termination reasons trigger this chargeback rule. \'lapse_only\' applies only to policies lapsed for non-payment; \'surrender_only\' applies to voluntary surrenders; \'all\' applies to any early termination regardless of reason.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this chargeback rule record. Used to detect rule changes and trigger downstream recalculation of in-flight chargeback obligations.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of this chargeback rule, incremented each time the rule is modified and re-approved. Enables historical tracking of rule changes and ensures correct rule version is applied to policies issued under prior schedules.']

  Note: 'Reference master defining chargeback rules by product type, distribution channel, and policy duration. Specifies chargeback period length (months), recapture percentage schedule by policy month, minimum premium threshold, and applicable distribution tiers. Governs when and how much commission is recaptured upon early policy termination. Managed within Sapiens Commission / Annocera rules engine.'
}

  channel_type varchar [note: 'The distribution channel through which the agent operates (e.g., career, independent, BGA, MGA, bank, direct). Bonus program eligibility and thresholds may vary by channel.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this bonus qualification record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']
  cumulative_ape decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total Annual Premium Equivalent (APE) accumulated by the agent within the qualification period as of the as_of_date. APE normalizes single and regular premium business to an annualized basis (single premium / 10 + regular premium) and is the primary production metric for bonus qualification in life insurance.']
  cumulative_nbv decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total New Business Value (NBV) generated by the agent within the qualification period as of the as_of_date. NBV represents the present value of future profits from new policies and is used in value-based bonus programs tied to profitability rather than volume.']
  cumulative_policy_count varchar [note: 'Total number of new business (NB) policies issued and in-force that the agent has placed within the qualification period as of the as_of_date. Used as a secondary qualification metric alongside APE.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.']
  dispute_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agent has formally disputed the qualification status or production metrics recorded in this record. When True, the record is placed under review and bonus payment may be held pending resolution.']
  dispute_resolution_date date [note: 'The date on which a formal dispute regarding this qualification record was resolved. Null if no dispute has been filed or if the dispute remains open.']
  disqualification_date date [note: 'The date on which the agent was determined to have failed to meet one or more mandatory qualification thresholds, resulting in disqualification from the bonus program for the period.']
  disqualification_reason varchar [note: 'The primary reason the agent was disqualified from the bonus program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: persistency_below_threshold|ape_shortfall|policy_count_shortfall|compliance_violation|license_lapse|e_o_violation|voluntary_withdrawal — promote to reference product]']
  estimated_bonus_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The projected bonus payout amount the agent would receive if current qualification status is maintained through the end of the period. Calculated based on current tier attainment and the bonus program\'s payout schedule. Used for agent motivation and financial accrual purposes.']
  manual_adjustment_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any production metrics or qualification status in this record have been manually adjusted by a commission administrator (e.g., to correct a data error or apply a business exception). Triggers audit trail requirements.']
  nbv_threshold decimal(18,2) [note: 'The minimum NBV the agent must generate within the qualification period to satisfy the NBV component of the bonus program. Applicable only to programs that include a value-based qualification criterion.']
  override_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agent is eligible to receive hierarchy-based override bonuses in addition to direct production bonuses, based on their position in the distribution hierarchy (e.g., GA, MGA, BGA overrides on downline production).']
  period_end_date date [note: 'The last date of the bonus qualification measurement window. Production activity after this date is not counted toward the current period\'s thresholds.']
  period_start_date date [note: 'The first date of the bonus qualification measurement window during which the agent\'s production activity is counted toward threshold attainment.']
  persistency_rate decimal(7,4) [note: 'The proportion of the agent\'s in-force policies that have remained active (not lapsed or surrendered) during the qualification period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9200 = 92%). Persistency is a key quality-of-business metric used in bonus qualification to discourage churning.']
  persistency_threshold decimal(7,4) [note: 'The minimum persistency rate the agent must maintain during the qualification period to satisfy the persistency component of the bonus program. Falling below this threshold may result in disqualification.']
  policy_count_gap varchar [note: 'The remaining number of new business policies the agent must place to reach the policy count threshold (policy_count_threshold minus cumulative_policy_count). Negative values indicate the threshold has been exceeded.']
  policy_count_threshold varchar [note: 'The minimum number of new business policies the agent must place within the qualification period to satisfy the policy count component of the bonus program.']
  product_line varchar [note: 'The insurance product line(s) whose new business production counts toward this bonus qualification (e.g., life, annuity, disability, long_term_care, all). Some bonus programs are product-line specific.']
  projected_qualification_date date [note: 'Estimated date by which the agent is projected to meet all bonus qualification thresholds based on current production pace. Used in agent motivation reporting and coaching conversations.']
  qualification_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the agent satisfied all required thresholds and achieved qualified status for the bonus program. Null if qualification has not yet been achieved.']
  qualification_number varchar [note: 'Externally visible business identifier for this bonus qualification record, used in agent statements, incentive reports, and dispute resolution (e.g., BQ-2024-00123456).']
  qualification_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the agent\'s bonus qualification for this program and period. \'in_progress\' indicates the period is active and thresholds not yet met or missed; \'qualified\' indicates all thresholds have been satisfied; \'disqualified\' indicates a threshold was permanently missed or a compliance violation occurred; \'pending_review\' indicates manual review is required; \'forfeited\' indicates the agent voluntarily or contractually relinquished eligibility.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this bonus qualification record originated (e.g., SAPIENS_COMMISSION, ANNOCERA). Supports data lineage and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this bonus qualification record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every recalculation of cumulative metrics or status change.']

  Note: 'Transactional record tracking an agent\'s progress toward bonus program qualification thresholds during a qualification period. Captures cumulative APE, policy count, NBV, persistency rate, and qualification status (in-progress, qualified, disqualified) per bonus program per agent per period. Enables real-time incentive tracking and agent motivation reporting.'
}

  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the bonus payment amount (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.']
  federal_tax_withheld decimal(18,2) [note: 'Amount of federal income tax withheld from the gross bonus payment, applied when backup withholding is required or elected. Reported on IRS Form 1099-NEC for the applicable tax year.']

  hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'The agent\'s position in the distribution hierarchy at the time of this bonus payment. Determines override bonus eligibility and multi-level payout calculations. MGA = Managing General Agent, GA = General Agent, BGA = Brokerage General Agency.']
  is_1099_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this bonus payment must be included in the agent\'s IRS Form 1099-NEC filing. Payments to incorporated entities (corporations) may be exempt from 1099 reporting under IRS rules.']
  net_payment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The actual amount disbursed to the agent after deducting federal and state tax withholding from the gross bonus amount. This is the amount reflected on the agent\'s commission statement and payment.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, or context related to this bonus payment. Used by commission administrators for exception handling and dispute documentation.']
  payment_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the bonus payment was disbursed to the agent or broker. Used for 1099 tax year assignment and cash flow reporting.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The disbursement method used to deliver the bonus payment to the agent. ACH and direct deposit are most common for recurring payments; wire for large awards; check for agents without electronic banking setup.']
  payment_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this bonus payment disbursement, used for reconciliation, agent statements, and 1099 tax reporting. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera incentive tracking module.']
  payment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the bonus payment disbursement. Tracks progression from pending approval through paid or cancelled/reversed states.']
  qualification_period_end date [note: 'End date of the performance measurement period during which the agent qualified for this bonus. Together with qualification_period_start, defines the full evaluation window.']
  qualification_period_start date [note: 'Start date of the performance measurement period during which the agent qualified for this bonus. Defines the window of production activity evaluated for eligibility.']
  reversal_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the reason for reversing or cancelling a previously issued bonus payment. Common reasons include policy lapse, qualification recalculation, agent termination, or data correction.']
  scheduled_payment_date date [note: 'The originally scheduled date for disbursement of the bonus payment, before any processing delays or holds. Enables variance analysis between scheduled and actual payment dates.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Identifies the operational system of record from which this bonus payment record originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  source_system_payment_code varchar [note: 'The native identifier of this bonus payment record in the originating operational system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer back to the system of record.']
  state_tax_withheld decimal(18,2) [note: 'Amount of state income tax withheld from the gross bonus payment, based on the agent\'s state of residence or the state\'s withholding requirements. Supports state-level 1099 reporting.']
  tax_year varchar [note: 'The calendar tax year to which this bonus payment is attributed for IRS 1099-NEC reporting purposes. Determines the tax reporting period for the agent\'s compensation.']
  tin_on_file varchar [note: 'The Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) — either SSN or EIN — on file for the agent at the time of payment. Masked for display (e.g., XXXXX1234). Required for IRS 1099-NEC reporting and backup withholding determination.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this bonus payment record was last modified. Tracks changes to payment status, amounts, or approval state for audit and reconciliation purposes.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of bonus and incentive award disbursements to agents and brokers upon successful qualification. Captures bonus program reference, qualification period, bonus amount, payment date, payment method, tax withholding, and net payment. Feeds 1099 tax reporting and is reconciled against bonus_qualification records. Sourced from Sapiens Commission / Annocera incentive tracking module.'
}

  period_end_date date [note: 'Last calendar date of the commission earning period covered by this statement. Defines the inclusive upper bound of the period for which commissions are summarized.']

  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this adjustment record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.']
  dac_adjustment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The corresponding DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) balance adjustment triggered by this commission correction. Required for GAAP ASC 944 and LDTI compliance to ensure commission capitalization records remain accurate.']
  direction varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the adjustment increases (positive) or decreases (negative) the agent\'s commission. Supports sign-agnostic reporting and reconciliation without relying on the sign of the adjustment_amount field alone.']
  distribution_channel varchar [note: 'The sales and distribution channel through which the underlying policy was sold. Affects applicable commission schedule rules, override eligibility, and regulatory reporting requirements by channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|independent_agent|brokerage|bank_channel|direct|worksite|tpa — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]']
  effective_date date [note: 'The business date on which the commission adjustment takes effect for accounting and payment purposes. For retroactive adjustments, this may precede the record creation date and determines the accounting period impacted.']
  hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'The distribution hierarchy tier of the agent receiving the adjusted commission. Determines override commission eligibility and multi-level payout recalculation scope. BGA (Brokerage General Agency) and MGA (Managing General Agent) levels may trigger cascading override adjustments.']
  initiated_by varchar [note: 'Identifies the initiating party or system that created the adjustment request. \'system\' indicates an automated rule-engine trigger (e.g., policy lapse detection); other values indicate human-initiated corrections from specific business functions.']
  nbv_impact_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The estimated change in NBV (New Business Value) attributable to this commission adjustment. Used by actuarial and finance teams to assess the profitability impact of commission corrections on new business metrics.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Additional free-text commentary entered by the approver or initiator providing supplemental context for the adjustment. Supports dispute resolution and internal audit review.']
  original_commission_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The commission amount as originally calculated and recorded on the source commission transaction prior to this adjustment. Retained for audit trail and variance analysis.']
  original_commission_rate decimal(8,6) [note: 'The commission rate (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.055000 = 5.5%) that was applied in the original commission transaction. Retained for rate variance analysis and retroactive rate change audits.']
  policy_year varchar [note: 'The policy duration year (1 = first year, 2 = renewal year 2, etc.) to which the adjusted commission applies. Determines whether FYC (First-Year Commission) or renewal commission rates govern the adjustment.']
  processed_date date [note: 'The date on which the approved adjustment was executed in the commission system and included in a payment run or ledger posting. Null for adjustments not yet processed.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'The insurance or annuity product category associated with the policy on which the commission adjustment is based. Drives applicable commission schedule rules and DAC (Deferred Acquisition Cost) accounting treatment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_life|term_life|universal_life|variable_universal_life|indexed_universal_life|fixed_annuity|fixed_indexed_annuity|variable_annuity|long_term_care|disability_income — promote to reference product]']
  reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or structured narrative describing the specific business reason for the commission adjustment. Required for audit trail compliance and commission dispute resolution. Examples: \'Rate table corrected per MGA contract amendment effective 2024-01-01\', \'Policy reinstated after lapse — FYC recalculated\'.']
  reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code classifying the root cause of the adjustment for systematic reporting and trend analysis. Complements the free-text adjustment_reason field. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: data_entry_error|rate_table_update|policy_endorsement|policy_lapse_reinstatement|1035_exchange|chargeback_waiver|hierarchy_correction|split_correction|advance_reconciliation — promote to reference product]']
  reversal_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this adjustment record is itself a reversal of a prior adjustment (True = reversal entry). Supports double-entry audit trail for commission ledger integrity.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record that originated this commission adjustment record. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and upstream source systems.']
  split_percentage decimal(5,4) [note: 'The proportion of the adjusted commission allocated to the primary agent when a co-agent split arrangement applies (expressed as a decimal, e.g., 0.6000 = 60%). Used to recalculate split amounts after adjustment.']
  tax_withholding_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Federal or state income tax withheld from the adjusted commission payment, if applicable. Relevant for agents subject to backup withholding per IRS regulations. Impacts 1099-MISC / 1099-NEC reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this commission adjustment record was last modified. Updated on every status transition, approval action, or data correction.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of manual or system-generated corrections to commission amounts outside of normal calculation cycles. Captures adjustment type (correction, retroactive rate change, policy change, reinstatement, 1035 exchange credit), original commission transaction reference, adjustment amount (positive or negative), adjustment reason, approver, and effective date. Supports audit trail for all post-calculation commission modifications.'
}

  accounting_period varchar [note: 'The financial accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which this commission run\'s payables are posted in the general ledger. Aligns commission expense recognition with GAAP ASC 944 and SAP statutory reporting requirements.']
  actual_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the commission calculation engine began processing this run. Used for performance monitoring, SLA compliance, and audit trail of processing timelines.']
  advance_recovery_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total amount recovered in this run against outstanding commission advances previously paid to agents. Deducted from gross commission before net payable calculation. Tracks advance repayment progress across run cycles.']
  agents_processed_count varchar [note: 'The total number of distinct agent and broker records for which commission calculations were performed in this run. Used for run completeness validation and agent payment reconciliation.']
  approval_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the commission run was formally approved for payment release by an authorized manager. Null until approval is granted. Supports SOX audit trail and dual-control documentation.']
  bonus_incentive_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total bonus and incentive compensation calculated in this run, including production bonuses, persistency bonuses, and contest awards. Separate from base commission for expense categorization and 1099 reporting.']
  completion_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time when the commission run finished processing, whether successfully completed or failed. Null if the run has not yet concluded. Used for SLA measurement and downstream payment release gating.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this commission run record was first created in the system. Serves as the immutable audit creation marker for data lineage and SOX compliance.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this commission run (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international distribution channels.']
  distribution_channel varchar [note: 'The agent distribution channel segment processed in this commission run. Determines applicable commission schedules, hierarchy override rules, and regulatory disclosure requirements. BGA = Brokerage General Agency; MGA = Managing General Agent; TPA = Third Party Administrator. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|independent_agent|bga|mga|broker_dealer|direct|tpa|bank — promote to reference product]']
  error_count varchar [note: 'The total number of error conditions encountered during this commission run that prevented individual transaction calculations from completing successfully. A non-zero value requires investigation before payment release.']
  error_description varchar [note: 'Summary description of the primary error or failure reason when the run status is \'failed\'. Provides operational context for troubleshooting and reprocessing decisions. Null for successful runs.']
  frequency varchar [note: 'The scheduled recurrence cadence for this commission run type. Drives the run calendar configuration in Sapiens Commission / Annocera and determines payment cycle expectations for agents and brokers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly|bi_weekly|semi_monthly|monthly|quarterly|annual|ad_hoc — promote to reference product]']
  fyc_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total first-year commission (FYC) component of gross commission calculated in this run, representing commissions earned on new business policies issued within their first policy year. Key metric for new business value (NBV) reporting and DAC amortization.']
  gross_commission_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total gross commission calculated across all agents and policies in this run before chargebacks, adjustments, or withholdings are applied. Represents the sum of all first-year (FYC), renewal, override, and bonus commissions earned in the period.']
  is_test_run boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this commission run was executed as a simulation or test cycle (True) rather than a production run (False). Test runs calculate commissions but do not generate actual payment transactions or 1099 reportable amounts.']
  net_payable_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The final net amount payable to agents and brokers in this commission run, calculated as gross commission minus chargebacks plus/minus adjustments. This is the amount released to the payment processing system for disbursement.']
  override_commission_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total hierarchy-based override commission calculated in this run, representing additional compensation paid to upline agents (GA, MGA, BGA) based on the production of their downline agents. Supports multi-level payout calculations.']
  payment_release_date date [note: 'The date on which commission payments from this run were approved and released to the payment processing system for disbursement to agents and brokers. Null until payments are released.']
  payment_release_status varchar [note: 'The approval and release status of commission payments generated by this run. Payments move from pending (run completed) to approved (management sign-off) to released (sent to payment system). Held or rejected statuses require remediation.']
  period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the commission earning period covered by this run. Defines the inclusive end boundary for policy transactions, premiums, and events eligible for commission calculation in this cycle.']
  period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the commission earning period covered by this run. Defines the inclusive start boundary for policy transactions, premiums, and events eligible for commission calculation in this cycle.']
  policies_processed_count varchar [note: 'The total number of policy records evaluated and processed during this commission run. Includes all policies with commission-eligible events within the run period. Used for run reconciliation and volume reporting.']
  product_line varchar [note: 'The insurance product line segment included in this commission run. Determines applicable commission rate schedules and regulatory reporting requirements. LTC = Long-Term Care. \'all\' indicates a cross-product run.']
  renewal_commission_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The total renewal commission component of gross commission calculated in this run, representing commissions earned on in-force policies beyond their first policy year. Distinct from FYC for DAC and expense ratio analysis.']
  run_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the commission run, formatted as CR-YYYY-MM-NNNNNN. Used in commission statements, audit trails, and dispute references.']
  run_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the commission run within the processing workflow. Transitions: scheduled → in_progress → completed or failed. Cancelled and on_hold are terminal or paused states requiring manual intervention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_progress|completed|failed|cancelled|on_hold — promote to reference product]']
  run_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the commission processing cycle indicating its business purpose. Regular runs are scheduled periodic cycles; off-cycle runs are unscheduled; adjustment runs correct prior period errors; reversal runs undo a prior run; bonus runs process incentive payouts; supplemental runs handle additional payments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|off_cycle|adjustment|reversal|bonus|supplemental — promote to reference product]']
  scheduled_run_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which this commission run was originally scheduled to execute. Used for SLA tracking, run calendar management, and reconciliation against actual execution date.']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record that originated this commission run record. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer and reconciliation between source systems.']
  source_system_run_ref varchar [note: 'The native run identifier or batch reference number assigned by the originating source system (Sapiens Commission or Annocera). Enables direct traceability back to the operational system record for audit and reconciliation.']
  tax_year varchar [note: 'The IRS tax year (YYYY) to which commission payments in this run are attributed for 1099-NEC reporting purposes. Critical for year-end tax reporting reconciliation and FinCEN AML compliance.']
  total_adjustment_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The net sum of all manual corrections, dispute resolutions, and prior-period adjustments applied in this commission run. May be positive (additional payment) or negative (reduction). Distinct from chargebacks which are rule-driven recaptures.']
  total_chargeback_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The aggregate amount of commission chargebacks applied in this run due to policy lapses, surrenders, cancellations, or other recapture events. Reduces gross commission to arrive at net payable.']
  total_tax_withheld_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'The aggregate federal and state income tax withheld from agent commission payments in this run, applicable for agents subject to backup withholding. Required for IRS 1099 tax reporting reconciliation.']
  transactions_generated_count varchar [note: 'The total number of individual commission transaction records created by this run, including first-year commissions (FYC), renewals, overrides, and service fees. Used for run output validation and downstream reconciliation.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this commission run record was most recently modified. Tracks status transitions, corrections, and any updates to run metadata for audit and change management purposes.']
  warning_count varchar [note: 'The total number of warning conditions flagged during this commission run that did not prevent processing but require review (e.g., missing licensing data, rate schedule gaps, hierarchy mismatches).']

  Note: 'Operational master record representing a scheduled commission calculation and payment processing cycle. Captures run type (regular, off-cycle, adjustment), run period start/end dates, run status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, failed), total policies processed, total commission calculated, total chargebacks applied, total net payable, and run completion timestamp. Provides the operational control record for each commission processing cycle in Sapiens Commission / Annocera.'
}

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GA|MGA|BGA|regional_director|national_director|district_manager — promote to reference product]']
  licensing_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the upline agent must hold a valid, active state insurance license in the jurisdiction of the producing policy for this override rule to apply. Enforces regulatory licensing compliance as an eligibility criterion.']

  max_override_cap_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Absolute dollar ceiling on the override commission payable under this rule per commission event or period. Applies when a percentage-based cap would still yield an excessive dollar amount. Complements max_override_cap_pct.']
  max_override_cap_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'The maximum allowable override percentage for this hierarchy level and product type, regardless of any negotiated or scheduled rate.   measurement_period_months varchar [note: 'The rolling or fixed number of months over which downline production is measured to assess eligibility for this override rule (e.g., 12 months for annual qualification). Used in conjunction with min_downline_production_amount.']
  min_downline_production_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Minimum annualized premium or New Business Value (NBV) that the upline agent\'s downline must produce within the measurement period for the override rule to be eligible. Enforces production-based eligibility thresholds for override compensation.']
  min_downline_production_basis varchar [note: 'The metric basis used to measure downline production for eligibility (e.g., Annual Premium Equivalent (APE), New Business Value (NBV), annualized premium, face amount, or policy count). Determines how min_downline_production_amount is evaluated.']
  nbv_weighted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the override percentage is applied to New Business Value (NBV) rather than gross premium or base commission amount. When true, the override_commission calculation engine uses NBV as the calculation basis.']
  override_level_number varchar [note: 'Numeric position of the hierarchy level in the multi-level override payout chain (e.g., 1 = immediate upline, 2 = second-level upline). Drives the hierarchy_path traversal in the override_commission calculation engine for multi-level payout.']
  override_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage rate applied to the base commission amount to calculate the override commission earned by the upline agent at this hierarchy level. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5.00%). Core driver of the override_commission calculation engine.']
  payment_frequency varchar [note: 'The frequency at which override commissions calculated under this rule are paid to the upline agent (e.g., monthly, quarterly, per commission event). Drives payment run scheduling in the commission management system.']
  payment_method varchar [note: 'The method by which override commission payments are disbursed to the upline agent (e.g., ACH direct deposit, check, wire transfer, or offset against outstanding balances). Drives payment processing in the commission management system.']
  policy_year varchar [note: 'The policy duration year (1 = first year, 2 = second year, etc.) to which this override percentage applies. Distinguishes first-year commission (FYC) override rates from renewal override rates across the policy lifecycle.']
  product_type_code varchar [note: 'Insurance product type to which this override rule applies. Drives differentiated override percentages by product line (e.g., Whole Life (WL), Universal Life (UL), Indexed Universal Life (IUL), Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA)). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WL|UL|IUL|VUL|term|FIA|SPIA|annuity|DI|LTC — promote to reference product]']
  rule_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this override rule within the commission management system. Used for cross-system reference and bordereaux reporting (e.g., \'OVR-GA-WL-001\').']
  rule_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the override rule\'s purpose, scope, and application logic. Supports audit review and compliance documentation.']
  rule_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable descriptive name for the hierarchy override rule (e.g., \'GA Whole Life Year-1 Override — Southeast Region\'). Used in commission statements and reporting.']
  rule_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the override rule governing whether it is applied in commission calculations. \'active\' = currently in use; \'superseded\' = replaced by a newer version; \'pending_approval\' = awaiting compliance sign-off.']
  source_system_code varchar [note: 'Code identifying the operational system of record from which this override rule was sourced (e.g., \'SAPIENS_COMM\', \'ANNOCERA\'). Supports data lineage tracking and ETL reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  stacking_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether multiple override rules at the same hierarchy level can be stacked (combined) for a single commission event. When false, only the highest applicable override rate is applied, preventing double-counting.']

  plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to product.product_plan. Business justification: Splits must reference product to apply correct split rules and validate agent product licensing. Product_type exists but plan_id FK enables product-specific split rule lookup and agent product authori']
  primary_split_producer_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the primary (writing) agent who holds principal responsibility for the policy sale. The primary agent typically receives the largest share of the commission split.']

  approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the split commission arrangement was formally approved by the designated approver. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Workflow approval status of the split commission arrangement. Split records must be approved before commission transactions are generated for co-agents. Supports compliance and supervisory review requirements.']

  chargeback_split_method varchar [note: 'Defines how chargeback amounts are allocated between the primary agent and co-agent when a policy lapses or is surrendered. Proportional applies chargeback in proportion to original split percentages; primary_first recovers from the primary agent first; co_agent_first recovers from the co-agent first; equal splits the chargeback equally.']

  co_agent_tin varchar [note: 'The Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) or Social Security Number (SSN) of the co-agent, required for IRS 1099 tax reporting of commission payments. Stored for compliance with IRS backup withholding rules.']
  commission_type varchar [note: 'Type of commission being split. First-Year Commission (FYC) applies to new business; renewal applies to in-force policy years; override applies to hierarchy-based overrides; bonus applies to incentive programs; service fee applies to ongoing policy servicing compensation.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this split commission record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this split commission record. Typically USD for domestic life insurance operations.']
  dispute_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this split commission arrangement is currently under dispute by one or more participating agents. When true, commission payments may be held pending resolution.']
  dispute_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the reason for the commission split dispute, as submitted by the disputing agent or their manager. Populated only when dispute_flag is true.']
  distribution_channel varchar [note: 'The distribution channel through which the policy was sold, determining applicable commission schedules and split rules. Includes career agent, Brokerage General Agency (BGA), Managing General Agent (MGA), broker-dealer, direct, Third Party Administrator (TPA), and bank channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: career_agent|bga|mga|broker_dealer|direct|tpa|bank — promote to reference product]']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which the split commission arrangement becomes effective. Commissions earned on or after this date are subject to the split percentages defined in this record.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which the split commission arrangement expires or is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended arrangement that remains in force until explicitly cancelled or superseded.']
  gross_commission_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The total gross commission amount subject to the split arrangement, before allocation to individual agents. Serves as the basis for calculating each agent\'s share per their split percentage.']
  hierarchy_level varchar [note: 'The distribution hierarchy level of the co-agent in this split arrangement. Used to validate that the split type and percentage are consistent with the agent\'s position in the hierarchy for multi-level payout calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agent|ga|mga|bga|regional_director|home_office — promote to reference product]']
  licensing_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the co-agent\'s insurance producer license has been verified as active and in good standing for the applicable state and product type prior to commission payment. Prevents unlicensed commission payments.']
  nbv_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The New Business Value (NBV) attributed to the policy sale, used when split_basis is NBV. Supports multi-level payout calculations tied to NBV production targets and hierarchy-based overrides.']
  policy_year varchar [note: 'The policy year (1 = first year, 2 = second year, etc.) in which the commission split applies. Determines whether FYC or renewal commission rates are used in the split calculation.']
  primary_agent_commission_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The calculated commission amount allocated to the primary writing agent based on their split percentage applied to the gross commission amount. Used to generate the primary agent\'s commission transaction.']
  primary_agent_split_pct decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage of the total commission allocated to the primary writing agent on this split record. Together with split_percentage for the co-agent, must sum to 100.00% across all split records for the transaction.']
  product_type varchar [note: 'Life insurance or annuity product type associated with the policy for which the commission is being split. Drives applicable commission rates and chargeback rules. Includes Whole Life (WL), Term, Universal Life (UL), Indexed Universal Life (IUL), Variable Universal Life (VUL), Annuity, Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA), Long-Term Care (LTC), and Disability Income (DI). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_life|term_life|ul|iul|vul|annuity|fia|ltc|di — promote to reference product]']
  source_system varchar [note: 'The operational system of record from which this split commission record originated. Supports data lineage, ETL reconciliation, and audit traceability in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  source_system_ref varchar [note: 'The native identifier or record key for this split commission record in the originating source system. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational system of record.']
  split_agreement_reference varchar [note: 'Reference number or document identifier for the signed split commission agreement between the participating agents and the company. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.']
  split_basis varchar [note: 'The basis on which the commission split percentage is applied. Options include annualized premium, target premium, face amount, New Business Value (NBV), or a flat dollar amount. Determines how the gross commission is allocated between agents.']
  split_number varchar [note: 'Externally-visible business identifier for this split commission record, used in commission statements, agent portals, and dispute resolution. Format: SC-YYYY-NNNNNN.']
  split_percentage decimal(7,4) [note: 'The percentage of the total commission allocated to the co-agent identified in this split record. All split records for a given commission transaction must sum to 100.00%. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 40.0000 = 40%).']
  split_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the split commission arrangement. Controls whether commission transactions are generated for each participating agent. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|approved|active|suspended|cancelled|expired — promote to reference product if additional statuses are needed]']
  split_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the commission split arrangement. Co-writer indicates joint policy ownership; case split reflects shared case management; referral split compensates a referring agent; broker split applies to broker-dealer arrangements; GA split applies to General Agent (GA) or Managing General Agent (MGA) arrangements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: co_writer|case_split|referral_split|broker_split|ga_split — promote to reference product]']
  tax_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the commission amounts allocated under this split arrangement are reportable on IRS Form 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC for each participating agent. Drives 1099 tax reporting for both primary and co-agents.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this split commission record was last modified. Tracks changes to split percentages, approval status, or other attributes for audit and compliance purposes.']

  Note: 'Association record managing commission splits between multiple agents who jointly sold or co-wrote a policy. Captures the primary agent, co-agent(s), split percentage per agent, split type (co-writer, case split, referral split), effective date, and approval status. Ensures total split percentages sum to 100% and supports accurate commission_transaction generation for each participating agent.'
}

  chargeback_period_months varchar [note: 'The number of months from policy issue date during which commissions paid under this contract are subject to chargeback recapture upon policy lapse or surrender.']
  compensation_basis varchar [note: 'The primary basis on which compensation is calculated under this contract. FYC (First-Year Commission) applies to new business; renewal applies to in-force policies; fee-based applies to service arrangements; hybrid combines multiple bases.']

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this compensation contract record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.']

  tax_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether compensation paid under this contract is subject to IRS 1099-MISC or 1099-NEC reporting requirements. Drives annual tax reporting obligations.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date on which the compensation contract ends and commission obligations cease. Nullable for open-ended contracts. Aligns with the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'The reason code for contract termination when the contract_status is terminated or expired. Drives chargeback enforcement, vesting forfeiture, and regulatory notification requirements.']

Table commission.schedule_product_rate {
  schedule_product_rate_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for this schedule-product rate assignment record. Primary key.']
  plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the product plan for which this commission schedule applies with product-specific rate overrides']
  schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to the commission schedule that defines the base rate structure and compensation rules']
  assignment_reason varchar [note: 'Business reason or justification for assigning this commission schedule to this product with these specific rates. Examples: \'New product launch promotion\', \'Regulatory compliance adjustment\', \'Competitive market positioning\', \'Legacy product wind-down\'. Used for audit and business analysis.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this schedule-product rate assignment record was created. Used for audit trail.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date on which this commission schedule becomes effective for this specific product plan. Allows different products to adopt the same schedule at different times based on regulatory approval or business rollout strategy.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'The date on which this commission schedule ceases to be effective for this specific product plan. Null indicates the assignment is currently active with no planned end date. Used when products are retired or commission structures are changed.']
  last_modified_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the compensation analyst who last modified this schedule-product rate assignment. Used for audit trail.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this schedule-product rate assignment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.']
  product_code varchar [note: 'Specific product identifier from the Policy Administration System to which this schedule applies. Enables granular schedule assignment at the product level rather than only at the product line level. May be null if the schedule applies to an entire product line. [Moved from commission_schedule: The product_code attribute in commission_schedule appears to link a schedule to a specific product, which contradicts the M:N relationship. If schedules truly apply to multiple products, this attribute should either be removed from commission_schedule or represents a default/primary product. In the M:N model, the specific product linkage is captured in the association via the plan_id FK, making product_code in the schedule table redundant or potentially misleading.]']
  product_specific_fyc_rate decimal(7,4) [note: 'Product-specific override of the First-Year Commission (FYC) rate for this schedule-product combination. When populated, this rate supersedes the base FYC rate defined in the commission schedule for this particular product. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 60.0000 = 60%). Null indicates the base schedule rate applies.']
  product_specific_renewal_rate decimal(7,4) [note: 'Product-specific override of the renewal commission rate for this schedule-product combination. When populated, this rate supersedes the base renewal rate defined in the commission schedule for this particular product. Expressed as a percentage. Null indicates the base schedule rate applies.']
  schedule_priority varchar [note: 'The priority rank used to resolve conflicts when multiple commission schedules could apply to the same product for a given agent and distribution channel. Lower numbers indicate higher priority (1 = highest priority). Used by the commission calculation engine to determine which schedule to apply when overlapping assignments exist.']
  created_by varchar [note: 'User ID or name of the compensation analyst who created this schedule-product rate assignment. Used for audit trail and accountability.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the rate assignment between commission schedules and product plans in the life insurance commission system. It captures product-specific commission rate overrides, effective date ranges, and schedule priority when multiple schedules could apply to the same product. Each record links one commission schedule to one product plan with rate and timing attributes that exist only in the context of this specific schedule-product pairing.. Existence Justification: In life insurance commission management, commission schedules are designed to apply across multiple product plans (e.g., a Career Agent Schedule 2024 covers 50+ products including WL, UL, IUL, VUL, and annuity products), and each product plan can be compensated under multiple commission schedules depending on distribution channel, agent tier, and market segment (e.g., a Term product has separate schedules for career agents, brokers, and IMOs). The business actively manages these schedule-product assignments with product-specific rate overrides, effective date ranges, and priority rankings to handle overlapping schedule applicability.'
}

Table commission.schedule_regulatory_compliance {
  schedule_regulatory_compliance_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for this commission schedule regulatory compliance record. Primary key.']

  compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current regulatory compliance status of this commission schedule under this specific state regulation. Tracks whether the schedule has been approved, is pending review, has been rejected, or is operating under a granted variance.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this compliance record was first created in the system.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date when this commission schedule became compliant and operationally effective under this state regulation. May differ from approval_date due to regulatory waiting periods or carrier implementation timelines.']

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this compliance record was last modified.']

  Note: 'This association product represents the regulatory compliance relationship between commission schedules and state-specific insurance regulations. It captures the state-by-state approval status, effective dates, expiration dates, and variance justifications for each commission schedule operating under each state\'s regulatory framework. Each record links one commission schedule to one state regulation with compliance tracking attributes that exist only in the context of this regulatory relationship.. Existence Justification: In life insurance operations, commission schedules must obtain regulatory approval from each state jurisdiction where they will be used, and each state regulation governs multiple commission schedules across carriers and product lines. Compliance teams actively manage state-by-state approval status, track effective and expiration dates, document variance justifications, and maintain filing reference numbers for each schedule-state combination. This is an operational compliance tracking relationship, not an analytical correlation.'
}

  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this plan version record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.']
  pbr_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this plan version is subject to Principle-Based Reserving under VM-20 (Valuation Manual Section 20). Determines reserve calculation methodology and actuarial opinion requirements.']
  profitability_target_irr decimal(5,2) [note: 'Target internal rate of return percentage for this plan version as established during product pricing. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 12.50 for 12.5%). Confidential business metric used for product performance monitoring.']

  retirement_announcement_date date [note: 'Date when the company publicly announced the retirement of this plan version. Supports agent communication and customer notification timelines. Null for non-retired versions.']
  retirement_reason varchar [note: 'Primary business driver for retiring this plan version. Regulatory change indicates compliance requirements; profitability reflects financial performance; product redesign signals strategic repositioning; market exit covers business line discontinuation; competitive pressure addresses market dynamics; technology limitation reflects system constraints.']
  rider_eligibility varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of rider codes or names that may be attached to policies issued under this plan version. Examples: ADB (Accidental Death Benefit), WP (Waiver of Premium), GMDB (Guaranteed Minimum Death Benefit), LTC (Long-Term Care). Governs product configuration options.']
  state_availability varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of US state and territory postal codes where this plan version is approved for sale. Supports multi-state product distribution and compliance tracking. Example: NY,CA,TX,FL.']
  superseded_date date [note: 'Date when this plan version is replaced by a subsequent version. Null for the current active version. Marks the end of new business eligibility for this version.']
  underwriting_class_structure varchar [note: 'Description of the risk classification framework for this plan version. Documents available underwriting classes such as Preferred Plus, Preferred, Standard Plus, Standard, Rated, and any substandard table ratings. Supports rate table selection and pricing.']
  version_description varchar [note: 'Narrative summary of this plan version including key features, target market, competitive positioning, and material changes from prior versions. Supports product training and agent sales materials.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Sequential or semantic version identifier for this plan iteration (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0-A). Supports both numeric and alphanumeric versioning schemes.']
  version_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of this plan version. Draft indicates work in progress; pending approval awaits regulatory review; active is available for new business; superseded is replaced by newer version but may have in-force policies; retired is closed to new business; withdrawn is cancelled before activation.']
  version_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the version change. New filing represents initial product launch; amendment covers contract language changes; rate revision updates premium or cost structures; benefit enhancement adds or modifies benefits; compliance update addresses regulatory requirements; retirement marks the terminal lifecycle event.']

  Note: 'Tracks versioned iterations of a product plan over its full lifecycle from initial filing through active sale to retirement. Captures version number, effective date, superseded date, change reason, filing reference, approval status, and version type (new filing, amendment, rate revision, retirement). For product retirement: records retirement announcement date, last new business effective date, in-force continuation policy, reason for retirement (regulatory, profitability, product redesign, market exit), replacement product plan reference, communication plan details, and closed-block transition parameters. Enables point-in-time product configuration retrieval for in-force policy administration, actuarial valuation, and closed-block management. The retirement version type marks the terminal lifecycle event and supports orderly transition of in-force blocks. This is the single source of truth for product versioning and retirement lifecycle management.'
}
